data.title: Radium Music Editor
data.author: ofalkaed
data.article_summary: Radium是一款具有创新界面的音乐编辑器，相较于钢琴卷帘界面，其编辑速度更快，屏幕可容纳更多音乐数据。与追踪器界面相比，它支持图形化编辑音符位置和效果，提供更多垂直空间和更好的音乐数据可视化。Radium也是一款数字音频工作站（DAW），支持录音、编辑和混音，兼具文本编辑功能。自1999年开始开发，现已支持Linux、Windows和Mac。其功能包括多轨音频和MIDI、自动化参数、颗粒合成、平滑滚动、可选钢琴卷帘、无损变更缩放、微调音高、脚本编写、多核支持、无限撤销/重做等。Radium为开源软件，并提供Pure Data和Faust环境，支持多种插件格式。用户可以通过订阅支持其开发并获取优先更新。

主要讨论点：音乐追踪软件（trackers）的特性、使用体验及其与现代数字音频工作站（DAW）的比较

不同观点：
• **对追踪软件的热情与期待**：
   - **drannex** 表达了对具备线性时间线和自动化/调制效果的追踪软件的期待，提到曾考虑自己开发类似工具。
  
• **对软件稳定性和性能的质疑**：
   - **gbraad** 提到在Windows上使用该软件的体验不佳，软件运行缓慢且不稳定，尤其在加载OctaMED文件时遇到问题。尽管如此，他表达了对追踪软件的偏好，并提到自己有丰富的追踪软件使用经验。
  
• **追踪软件的历史与优势**：
   - **bane** 解释了追踪软件的历史和优势，强调其快速的工作流程和紧凑的多轨表示，适合快速迭代音乐创意。他还指出，追踪软件界面类似于编程，能让人更直接地接触音乐和乐器。

• **对具体功能和工具的兴趣**：
   - **Zambyte** 对软件中的Scheme脚本功能表示兴趣，询问其他人的使用经验。
   - **weinzierl** 对软件中使用LLVM技术表示好奇。

• **与其他DAW的比较**：
   - **RankingMember** 希望了解该追踪软件与Reaper的区别。
   - **brcmthrowaway** 询问该软件与Nodal的比较。
   - **ConanRus** 指出Renoise是最受欢迎的追踪软件之一。

补充讨论：
• **软件的实用性和社区支持**：
   - **bane** 提到大多数追踪软件是免费或非常便宜的，并且有丰富的文档和示例支持。
  
• **软件的开发状态和跨平台问题**：
   - **fabiofzero** 提到该软件的开发历时很长但稳定性一直是个问题，不过认为值得再次尝试。
   - **DidYaWipe** 提到Mac版本的问题，并表示如果理解追踪软件的界面可能会更感兴趣。
  
• **用户个人体验**：
   - **leothetechguy** 表示自己非常喜欢该软件，认为其值得购买。

• **历史参考和资源**：
   - **pvg** 提到2015年相关讨论线程。
   - **tenkabuto** 提供软件的使用手册和非官方视频教程链接。

• **对特定技术或工具的怀旧和支持**：
   - **bigfishrunning** 对s7 scheme工具的应用表示赞赏，认为其为程序添加了很好的脚本功能。

争议焦点：
• **软件的稳定性与跨平台兼容性**：部分用户（如gbraad）对Windows版本的性能和兼容性表示不满，而其他用户（如leothetechguy）则对软件表示高度赞赏，认为其值得购买。这种体验上的差异可能源于不同平台的技术实现问题。

About Radium
Radium is a music editor with a new type of interface.
Compared to the
piano roll interface
,
editing is quicker
and
more musical data fits on the screen
.
(Radium has a piano roll as well.)
Compared to the
tracker interface
,
note positions and effects can be edited graphically
. Graphical editing provides
more vertical space
and gives a
better visualization of musical data
.
(Everything can also be edited by text, like in a normal tracker, combining the best of two worlds.)
Radium is also a
Digitial Audio Workstation
(DAWg), which can be used to record, edit, and mix audio.
However, despite its unusual appearance, it's a design goal for Radium to be
straightforward to use, and easy to learn
.
It should not be harder to learn Radium than any tracker or most MIDI sequencers.
Users accustomed to trackers might use more time adjusting to the interface.
History
The development of Radium started in 1999 based on ideas developed 1997-1999 while extending the Octamed tracker on the Amiga.
The first public version of Radium was released in 2000.
Since then, Radium has been ported to Linux, Windows, and Mac.
Today, Radium is probably the worlds largest and most advanced tracker-like music editor.
Some of the features
Audio and MIDI multitracker
Automate pitch, velocity, effects, and tempo.
Granular synthesis
Smooth scrolling
Optional piano roll
Tickless
Global swing, and swing-per-track
Modular mixer and/or mixer strips
MIDI sequencing
Hard drive audio recording and playback
AU, LADSPA, LV2, VST, and VST3 plugins
(More than 100 LADSPA plugins are included)
Several built-in effects and instruments
(virtual instruments, multiband compressor, modulators, etc.)
Pure Data
embedded.
(Linux only for now)
Includes a
Faust
audio DSP development environment
Frame-accurately synchronize playback to e.g.
Ardour
,
Bitwig
, or
MASCHINE
.
Graphical zoom
Non-destructive changable Lines Per Beat ("Line Zoom").
Microtonality
Scripting in Python or Scheme.
Plugin delay compensation applied to all parts of the audio graph
Multicore support
Unlimited undo/redo
Open source with a straightforward and easy to use build system (no CMake or IDEs).
Quick start
Load a demo song from the File menu.
Play by pressing space.
Add a new note to the editor by pressing a key on the computer keyboard. Change octave with F1 and F2.
(Or record from MIDI input)
Look at the
manual.

data.title: Smollm3: Smol, multilingual, long-context reasoner LLM
data.author: kashifr
data.article_summary: SmolLM3是一款小型、多语言、支持长上下文推理的30亿参数语言模型，性能超越Llama-3.2-3B和Qwen2.5-3B，并可与40亿参数模型竞争。该模型支持6种语言，采用Transformer解码器架构，结合了Grouped Query Attention、NoPE等技术以提升效率和长上下文表现。通过三阶段预训练方法和混合推理模式，SmolLM3在多项任务中表现出色。其完整工程蓝图和训练方法已在GitHub上发布，包括架构细节、数据混合策略和训练配置，为开发者提供了详细的指导。模型训练使用了384块H100 GPU，耗时24天。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：SmolLM3模型的性能、开源贡献、实际应用及技术挑战

不同观点：
• WhitneyLand：认为SmolLM3在3B级别达到了当前顶尖性能，并赞赏其完全公开模型、代码及训练方法，提供了一个可复现的框架。同时，指出训练成本较高，约需百万美元的GPU时间。
• lvl155：强调该模型对于初学LLM的人是一个很好的学习材料，有助于快速上手。
• gardnr：指出SmolLM3模型小巧但性能优异，特别适合边缘设备和移动部署，并提到其双模式推理功能和公开的完整训练方法，节省了反向工程的时间。
• danielhanchen：分享了修复chat模板问题的具体操作步骤，提供了技术上的帮助。
• simonw：遇到了在Mac上运行该模型的问题，尝试多种方法后仅能在CPU模式下运行，但速度很慢，寻求其他解决方案。
• _1：关注适合企业数据集微调的小模型，希望能够在浏览器和移动设备上运行而不依赖云资源。
• gdiamos：赞赏SmolLM3的同时，希望继续开发50-100M参数的模型，认为这些模型在CPU上快速完成任务有其价值。
• BarakWidawsky：指出SmolLM3未使用自有RL，而是通过大型数据集的推理痕迹进行微调，并从大型模型生成推理痕迹。
• msgodel：认为SmolLM3接近Qwen3的压缩版，质量很高，计划用于本地代理和代码补全，并提到自己的代码已过时，技术更新速度很快。
• eachro：询问SmolLM3的微调难度，与其他MoE LLMs的微调难度作比较。
• tiahura：好奇多语言支持占用了多少模型参数。
• grrowl：赞赏Huggingface在CodeEval和Python工具上的坚持，认为目前对LLM编写和执行代码的能力未被充分开发。
• ivape：质疑SmolLM3是否比OpenRouter上的llama 3.1 8b更便宜，并指出3B模型正被默认用于设备上，如Apple和Google的nano。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点：SmolLM3在不同硬件和软件环境下的运行问题，特别是Mac上的运行挑战。
• 重要论据：SmolLM3的公开透明性、性能优势、在边缘设备和移动设备上的适用性、以及与其他模型的比较。
• 其他值得注意的讨论点：模型的微调难度、多语言支持的参数占用、以及未来小参数模型的发展潜力。

Small language models are becoming increasingly important as users seek capable models that can be deployed efficiently. The community has produced a fascinating range of capable small models, each pushing the boundaries of what's possible at this scale. With SmolLM3, we're excited to contribute a new competitive fully open 3B model:
Base model:
https://hf.co/HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM3-3B-Base
Instruct and reasoning model:
https://hf.co/HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM3-3B
SmolLM3 sits in the efficiency sweet spot.
Our 3B model outperforms Llama-3.2-3B and Qwen2.5-3B while staying competitive with larger 4B alternatives (Qwen3 & Gemma3). Beyond the performance numbers, we're sharing exactly how we built it using public datasets and training frameworks.
Model summary:
3B model
trained on 11T tokens, SoTA at the 3B scale and competitive with 4B models
Instruct model
with
dual mode reasoning,
supporting
think
/
no_think
modes
Multilingual support
for 6 languages: English, French, Spanish, German, Italian, and Portuguese
Long context
up to 128k with NoPE and using YaRN
The complete recipe:
We're releasing SmolLM3 with our engineering blueprint. It includes architecture details, exact data mixtures showing how we progressively boost performance across domains in a three-stage pretraining approach, and the methodology for building a hybrid reasoning model. Usually, achieving these results would require months of reverse engineering. Instead, we're providing the full methodology.
Whether you're building your own models or want to understand what drives performance at this scale, this blueprint shows the engineering story behind competitive 3B performance.
Let’s have a look at the pretraining stage.
Pretraining
SmolLM3 both changed the architecture and data mixture over its predecessors. Let’s have a look at the architecture and training configurations first!
Architecture and training details
SmolLM3 follows a transformer decoder architecture with tied embedding similar to SmolLM2, building on Llama architecture with some key modifications optimized for efficiency and long context performance.
Grouped Query Attention (GQA):
We replaced multi-head attention with grouped-query attention using 4 groups. Our ablations on a 3B model trained with 100B tokens from
FineWeb-Edu
showed that GQA matches the performance of multi-head attention while significantly reducing the KV cache size during inference.
NoPE:
We implemented NoPE from "
RoPE to NoRoPE and Back Again: A New Hybrid Attention Strategy
" (Yang et al., 2025), selectively removing rotary position embeddings from every 4th layer. This approach improves long context performance without affecting short context capabilities, as confirmed by our ablations.
Intra-Document Masking:
During training, we use attention masking to ensure tokens from different documents in the same training sequence don't attend to each other. Similar to Llama 3, this helps with faster and more stable long context training while maintaining short context performance.
Training Stability:
Following OLMo 2, we remove weight decay from embedding layers to improve training stability. This modification contributed to more stable training dynamics, with embedding norms naturally stabilizing at healthier values during training without impacting overall performance in our ablations.
All these changes were validated through ablations using the same 3B architecture trained on 100B tokens from FineWeb-Edu, ensuring each modification either improved performance or maintained it while offering other benefits.
Training Configuration: We use a global batch size of 2.36M tokens with 4096 sequence length, a learning rate of 2e-4, and the AdamW optimizer (beta1: 0.9, beta2: 0.95) with weight decay of 0.1 and gradient clipping of 1. We use the WSD (Warmup-Stable-Decay) scheduler, with 2000  warmup steps, and a linear decay to 0 in the final 10% training steps. We use
nanotron
framework for the training,
datatrove
for data processing and
lighteval
for evaluation. The model was trained on 384 H100 GPUs for 24 days. You can see the distributed training setup in the following figure.

• _1：关注适合企业数据集微调的小模型，希望能够在浏览器和移动设备上运行而不依赖云资源。
• gdiamos：赞赏SmolLM3的同时，希望继续开发50-100M参数的模型，认为这些模型在CPU上快速完成任务有其价值。
• BarakWidawsky：指出SmolLM3未使用自有RL，而是通过大型数据集的推理痕迹进行微调，并从大型模型生成推理痕迹。
• msgodel：认为SmolLM3接近Qwen3的压缩版，质量很高，计划用于本地代理和代码补全，并提到自己的代码已过时，技术更新速度很快。
• eachro：询问SmolLM3的微调难度，与其他MoE LLMs的微调难度作比较。
• tiahura：好奇多语言支持占用了多少模型参数。
• grrowl：赞赏Huggingface在CodeEval和Python工具上的坚持，认为目前对LLM编写和执行代码的能力未被充分开发。
• ivape：质疑SmolLM3是否比OpenRouter上的llama 3.1 8b更便宜，并指出3B模型正被默认用于设备上，如Apple和Google的nano。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点：SmolLM3在不同硬件和软件环境下的运行问题，特别是Mac上的运行挑战。
• 重要论据：SmolLM3的公开透明性、性能优势、在边缘设备和移动设备上的适用性、以及与其他模型的比较。
• 其他值得注意的讨论点：模型的微调难度、多语言支持的参数占用、以及未来小参数模型的发展潜力。

data.article_summary: 本文描述了作者如何发现并利用一款名为Catwatchful的安卓间谍软件服务中的SQL注入漏洞，最终获取了超过6万个间谍用户账户的数据。作者首先通过注册一个免费试用账户，发现该服务同时在Firebase和一个自定义服务器上创建账户。在分析其流量后，作者注意到用户数据存储在Firebase中，难以直接攻击，但注册时涉及的另一个服务器（catwatchful.pink）存在SQL注入漏洞。通过利用该漏洞，作者成功获取了大量用户的敏感信息，揭示了该间谍软件在安全性上的重大缺陷。

data.title: Brut: A New Web Framework for Ruby
data.author: onnnon
data.article_summary:
Brut是一个简约但功能齐全的Ruby web框架，不同于其他框架，它没有控制器、动词或资源，而是直接构建页面、表单和单一操作处理器。Brut注重低抽象和低仪式感，但并非像Sinatra那样的低级框架。它内置OpenTelemetry仪表盘、基于Sequel的数据访问层以及基于OptionParser的命令行应用。

Brut安装简便，支持Docker快速启动。其核心设计基于类和对象，避免了过多的include和动态方法。它统一了客户端和服务器端表单验证，并通过BrutJS提供自定义元素。使用esbuild处理CSS，无需PostCSS或SASS。

Brut默认设置良好实践，如内容安全策略和数据库非空约束。它使用RSpec进行测试，支持Phlex生成HTML，并避免使用YAML进行配置。Brut简化了开发，消除了不必要的抽象和辩论，让开发者专注于编写Ruby和HTML，享受构建web应用的过程。

接下来，作者将继续完善Brut并发布1.0版本。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕新web框架Brut的评价和讨论，涉及技术实现、框架对比、许可证问题以及实际使用反馈。

不同观点：
• **框架设计和实现的看法**：
   - [rorylaitila] 支持以表单和页面为核心的设计，认为控制器被过度使用，主张通过框架更优雅地处理验证和交互，强调表单和视图的重要性。
   - [sarchertech] 提到可以使用更高级的函数式编程概念（如monad、代数数据类型等），但认为这些不是必须的，适合小项目或由高级开发者参与的项目。

• **与其他框架的对比**：
   - [freedomben] 认为Brut是Sinatra和Rails之间的良好折中，适合不需要Rails复杂的简单应用。
   - [hamzakc] 建议考虑Roda框架，暗示可能有其他更合适的选择。
   - [gavmor] 提到Brut的命名方式避免了资源路由的混淆问题，但同时也提出了新的潜在问题。

• **许可证问题的讨论**：
   - [ilvez] 对Brut的特殊许可证表示关注，质疑是否影响源码查看。
   - [wrs] 和 [cosmojg] 详细讨论了Brut的HIPPOCRATIC LICENSE的细节，特别是其对使用者商业行为的严格限制，[wrs] 还提到需要检查供应链的道德问题。

• **实际使用反馈**：
   - [heeton] 在尝试登录示例网站时遇到错误，表明实际使用中可能存在问题。
   - [naveed125] 尽管不使用Ruby，但对Brut表示兴趣，可能因此尝试使用Ruby。
   - [joewhale] 和 [plastic-enjoyer] 对框架表示简单赞赏，没有深入讨论技术细节。

补充讨论：
• **对Sorbet和类型系统的兴趣**：
   - [Lio] 提到David的《Sustainable Rails》一书，并表示对Brut完全采用Sorbet进行类型检查的兴趣，但担心可能违背渐进类型方法。

• **其他资源推荐**：
   - [Alifatisk] 提到Brut官网的介绍页面，提供了更多信息来源。
   - [raggi] 将Brut与Camping框架进行比较，指出其在动态父类构造函数上的不同。

争议焦点：
• 许可证的严格规定可能对使用者造成一定限制和负担，尤其是对供应链道德要求的审查。
• 框架设计上，控制器的使用和表单驱动设计的优劣存在不同看法。

Brut
aims to be a simple, yet fully-featured web framework for Ruby. It's different than other Ruby web frameworks.  Brut has no controllers, verbs, or resources. You build pages, forms, and single-action handlers. You write HTML, which is generated on the server. You can write all the JavaScript and CSS you want.
Hereâs a web page that tells you what time it is:
class
TimePage
<
AppPage
def
initialize
(
clock
:)
@clock
=
clock
end
def
page_template
header
do
h1
{
"Welcome to the Time Page!"
}
TimeTag
(
timestamp:
@clock
.
now
)
end
end
end
Brut is built around low-abstraction and low-ceremony, but is not low-level like Sinatra.  Itâs a web framework. Your Brut apps have builtin OpenTelemetry-based instrumentation, a
Sequel
-powered data access layer, and developer automation based on
OptionParser
-powered command-line apps.
Brut
can be installed right now, and you can build and run an
app in minutes. You donât even have to install Ruby.
> docker run \
-v "$PWD":"$PWD" \
-w "$PWD" \
-it \
thirdtank/mkbrut \
mkbrut my-new-app
> cd my-new-app
> dx/build && dx/start
> dx/exec bin/setup
> dx/exec bin/dev
# => localhost:6502 is waiting
Thereâs a full-fledged example app called
ADRs.cloud
you can run right now and see how it works.
What You Get
Brut has extensive documentation
, however these are some highlights:
Brutâs core design is around classes that are instantiated into objects, upon which methods are called.
No excessive
include
calls to create a massive blob of functions.
No Hashes of Whatever. Your session, flash, and form parameters are all actual classes and defined data types.
Minimal reliance of dynamically-defined methods or
method_missing
.  Almost every
method
has documentation
.
Brut leverages the modern Web Platform.
Client-side and server-side form validation is unified into one user experience.
BrutJS
is an ever-evolving
library
of autonomous custom elements AKA web components to progressively enhance your
HTML.
With
esbuild
, you can write regular CSS and have
it instantly packaged, minified, and hashed. No PostCSS, No SASS.
Brut sets up good practices by default.
Your app will have a reasonable content security policy.
Your database columns arenât null by default.
Your foreign keys will a) exist, b) be indexed, and c) not be nullable by
default.
Time, available through Brutâs
Clock
, is always timezone-aware.
Localization is there and is as easy as we can make it. We hope to make it easier.
Brut uses awesome Ruby gems
RSpec is how you write your tests. Brut includes custom matchers to make it
easier to focus on what your code should do.
Faker and FactoryBot will set up your test and dev data
Phlex generates your HTML. No, we wonât be supporting HAML.
Brut doesnât recreate configuration with YAML.
I18n uses the
i18n gem
, with translations
in a Ruby Hash
. No YAML.
Dynamic configuration is in the environment, managed in dev and test by
the
dotenv gem
. No YAML.
OK, the dev environmentâs
docker-compose.dx.yml
is YAML. But thatâs
it
.
YAML, not even
once
twice.
Brut doesnât create abstractions where none were needed.
Is this the index action of the widgets resource or the show action of the widget-list resource?
is a question you will never have to ask yourself or your team. The widgets page is called
WidgetsPage
and available at
/widgets
.
My
Widgets
class accesses the
WIDGETS
table, but it also has all the domain logic of a widget!
No it doesnât.
DB::Widget
gets your data.  You can make
Widget
do whatever you want. Heck, make a
WidgetService
for all we care!
What if our HTML had controllers but they were not the same as the controllers in our back-end?
There arenât any controllers. You donât want them, you donât have to make them.
What about monads or algebraic data types or currying or maybe having everything
be a
Proc
because
call
?!
You donât have to understand any part of that question.  But if you want your business logic to use functors, go for it. We wonât stop you.
WHY?!?!?!
I know, we can vibe away all the boilerplate required for Rails apps.  But how much fun is that?  How much do you enjoy setting up RSpec, again, in your new Rails app? How tired are you of changing the âfront end solutionâ every few years?  And arenât you just
tired
of debating where your business logic goes or if itâs OK to use HTTP
DELETE
(tunneled over a
_method
param in a
POST
) to archive a widget?
I know I am.
I want to have fun building web apps, which means I want write Ruby, use HTML, and leverage the browser. Do you know how awesome browsers are now?  Also, Ruby 3.4 is pretty great as well. Iâd like to use it.
What I
donât
want is endless flexibility, constant architectural decision-making, or pointless debates about stuff that doesnât matter.
I just want to have fun building web apps.
Next Steps
I will continue working
toward a 1.0 of Brut
, building web apps and enjoying the process.  I hope you will, too!

Brut是一个简约但功能齐全的Ruby web框架，不同于其他框架，它没有控制器、动词或资源，而是直接构建页面、表单和单一操作处理器。Brut注重低抽象和低仪式感，但并非像Sinatra那样的低级框架。它内置OpenTelemetry仪表盘、基于Sequel的数据访问层以及基于OptionParser的命令行应用。

Brut安装简便，支持Docker快速启动。其核心设计基于类和对象，避免了过多的include和动态方法。它统一了客户端和服务器端表单验证，并通过BrutJS提供自定义元素。使用esbuild处理CSS，无需PostCSS或SASS。

Brut默认设置良好实践，如内容安全策略和数据库非空约束。它使用RSpec进行测试，支持Phlex生成HTML，并避免使用YAML进行配置。Brut简化了开发，消除了不必要的抽象和辩论，让开发者专注于编写Ruby和HTML，享受构建web应用的过程。

接下来，作者将继续完善Brut并发布1.0版本。
44502463.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕新web框架Brut的评价和讨论，涉及技术实现、框架对比、许可证问题以及实际使用反馈。

不同观点：
• **框架设计和实现的看法**：
   - [rorylaitila] 支持以表单和页面为核心的设计，认为控制器被过度使用，主张通过框架更优雅地处理验证和交互，强调表单和视图的重要性。
   - [sarchertech] 提到可以使用更高级的函数式编程概念（如monad、代数数据类型等），但认为这些不是必须的，适合小项目或由高级开发者参与的项目。

• **与其他框架的对比**：
   - [freedomben] 认为Brut是Sinatra和Rails之间的良好折中，适合不需要Rails复杂的简单应用。
   - [hamzakc] 建议考虑Roda框架，暗示可能有其他更合适的选择。
   - [gavmor] 提到Brut的命名方式避免了资源路由的混淆问题，但同时也提出了新的潜在问题。

• **许可证问题的讨论**：
   - [ilvez] 对Brut的特殊许可证表示关注，质疑是否影响源码查看。
   - [wrs] 和 [cosmojg] 详细讨论了Brut的HIPPOCRATIC LICENSE的细节，特别是其对使用者商业行为的严格限制，[wrs] 还提到需要检查供应链的道德问题。

• **实际使用反馈**：
   - [heeton] 在尝试登录示例网站时遇到错误，表明实际使用中可能存在问题。
   - [naveed125] 尽管不使用Ruby，但对Brut表示兴趣，可能因此尝试使用Ruby。
   - [joewhale] 和 [plastic-enjoyer] 对框架表示简单赞赏，没有深入讨论技术细节。

补充讨论：
• **对Sorbet和类型系统的兴趣**：
   - [Lio] 提到David的《Sustainable Rails》一书，并表示对Brut完全采用Sorbet进行类型检查的兴趣，但担心可能违背渐进类型方法。

data.title: GlobalFoundries to Acquire MIPS
data.author: mshockwave
data.article_summary: 2025年7月8日，格芯（GlobalFoundries）宣布收购MIPS，以增强其在人工智能和计算能力方面的布局。此次收购将扩展格芯的定制IP产品组合，特别是在RISC-V处理器IP和实时计算软件工具方面，应用于自动驾驶、工业自动化、数据中心和智能边缘等领域。MIPS近期推出了基于RISC-V的Atlas处理器IP系列及虚拟优化平台Atlas Explorer，旨在提升性能和效率。格芯表示，收购MIPS将增强其提供灵活的RISC-V开放平台解决方案的能力，并结合其制造技术，助力客户打造更高效的产品。MIPS将成为格芯旗下的独立运营业务，继续服务其客户。收购预计在2025年下半年完成。

Discover the Latest from MIPS
Product News, Industry Insights, Announcements, and More
GlobalFoundries to Acquire MIPS to Accelerate AI and Compute Capabilities
July 8, 2025
Acquisition will expand GF portfolio with cutting-edge RISC-V processor IP and software tools for real-time computing in autonomous mobility, industrial automation, datacenter and intelligent edge applications
MALTA, N.Y., and San Jose, Calif., July 8, 2025
– GlobalFoundries (Nasdaq: GFS) (GF) today announced a definitive agreement to acquire MIPS, a leading supplier of AI and processor IP. This strategic acquisition will expand GF’s portfolio of customizable IP offerings, allowing it to further differentiate its process technologies with IP and software capabilities.
“MIPS brings a strong heritage of delivering efficient, scalable compute IP tailored for performance-critical applications, which strategically aligns with the evolving demands of AI platforms across diverse markets,” said Niels Anderskouv, president and chief operating officer at GlobalFoundries. “Through this acquisition, we will expand our capabilities to offer customers more flexible, RISC-V-based open platform solutions, paired with our differentiated process technologies and world-class manufacturing to help them build world-class products. This acquisition will be a powerful step forward to push the boundaries of efficiency and performance across a broad range of applications in automotive, industrial and datacenter infrastructure.”
MIPS recently expanded its processor IP offerings, based on open RISC-V specification, with the launch of its Atlas portfolio, a comprehensive suite of compute cores designed for real-time and application processing as well as specialized AI edge processing cores. Additionally, MIPS also introduced Atlas Explorer, a virtual platform that enables optimization of performance, power and area to shift-left in the design cycle.
“Becoming part of GlobalFoundries marks the start of a bold new chapter for MIPS,” said Sameer Wasson, CEO of MIPS. “GF’s proven track record in delivering differentiated technologies through a secure, global manufacturing footprint will enhance our ability to accelerate innovation and scale our solutions—unlocking new opportunities in the Physical AI space and driving even greater value for our customers.”
The acquisition of MIPS is subject to the satisfaction of customary closing conditions, including the receipt of required regulatory approvals, and is expected to be completed in the second half of 2025. Following the acquisition, MIPS will continue to operate as a standalone business within GF and serve its customers across a broad range of technologies.
About MIPS
MIPS is the leading provider of compute subsystems for autonomous platforms in automotive, industrial, and embedded markets. With a 40-year heritage in RISC computing innovation and safety capable processing, MIPS is uniquely positioned to simplify the adoption of Physical AI in industrial robotics and automotive applications. MIPS technology is based on the open specification RISC-V instruction set architecture, featuring MIPS pioneering, patented, multi-threaded capabilities to move beyond proprietary legacy architecture lock-ins. For more information, please visit MIPS.com.
About GF
GlobalFoundries (GF) is a leading manufacturer of essential semiconductors the world relies on to live, work and connect. We innovate and partner with customers to deliver more power-efficient, high-performance products for the automotive, smart mobile devices, internet of things, communications infrastructure and other high-growth markets. With our global manufacturing footprint spanning the U.S., Europe and Asia, GF is a trusted and reliable source for customers around the world. Every day, our talented and diverse team delivers results with an unyielding focus on security, longevity and sustainability. For more information, visit www.gf.com.

data.title: On The Meaning of Ritual
data.author: jger15
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：荀子思想中 ritual（礼仪/仪式）的现代意义及其应用

不同观点：
• buntsai 认为作者强调 ritual 的重要性是有道理的，但建议创造新 ritual 则是自大和天真的。他指出，中国在2500年前失去了支撑社会的 ritual 实践，并质疑是否应该简单地发明新的 ritual。他还通过提到阿道司·赫胥黎的《美德之后》（After Virtue）来警告创造新 ritual 的危险性，特别是与极权主义政权（如轴心国）的关联。
• polivier 分享了个人经历，强调 ritual 带来的安慰感，尤其是在面对生活中的重大事件（如出生、购房、退休、失去亲人等）时。他描述了如何通过特定的仪式行为（如喝特别的酒）来应对这些时刻，并从中获得平和感。
• eszed 认为评论中对 ritual 的讨论偏离了文章中的定义。文章中的 ritual 概念非常宽泛，涵盖了任何社会行为或社会假设，而不仅仅是传统意义上的仪式。他建议可能需要一个更贴切的术语来描述这个概念。
• alganet 对使用东方哲学文本持谨慎态度，尤其是当这些文本被用来操纵西方观众时。他质疑是否可以通过“西方视角”将所谓的“古老智慧”应用于现代生活，并特别提到文章中建议的21世纪统治意识形态的道德和有效性。
• marcus_holmes 反对文章中关于权威主义的核心假设，即人类天生会为了资源而争斗，因此需要国家权威来维持秩序。他认为，大多数人能够在没有外部强制的情况下合作，并建立和谐的社区。他承认暴力的存在可能需要权威的干预，但总体上质疑权威主义的必要性。
• indiebat 认为，关于古代仪式或神话的宏大宣称并不自动使其伟大。他建议，从西方经典（如莎士比亚、蒙田）中获取智慧更为实际，并质疑东方哲学是否真的比西方哲学更有深度。
• pessimizer 认为 ritual 是一种浪费资源的行为，但它通过展示承诺和牺牲来建立信任。他指出，昂贵的仪式可以 discourage 多重承诺，并通过 sunk cost fallacy（沉没成本谬误）来增强对某一团体或目标的忠诚度。尽管语气较为冷淡，他承认 ritual 在建立信任和承诺方面的实际效用。
• gerdesj 认为“ritual”一词在讨论中被过度使用，并质疑是否应该深入探讨圣经、托拉和古兰经等其他宗教经典。他认为这种讨论是无意义的“自慰”。

补充讨论：
• 评论中多次提到 ritual 的定义问题，特别是其在现代社会中的应用和意义。
• 关于是否应该创造新 ritual，以及古代 ritual 在现代社会中的价值，存在明显争议。
• 一些评论者质疑东方哲学在西方背景下的适用性，并建议从西方经典中获取智慧。
• 对 ritual 的功能和效用存在不同看法，有人认为它带来安慰和秩序，有人则认为它是浪费资源或与权威主义有关。

data.title: Particle Lenia Deluxe Edition
data.author: CraftingLinks
data.article_summary: 本文介绍了**Particle Lenia Deluxe Edition**，一个基于细胞自动机**Lenia**的项目，该项目通过GPU加速实现了3D粒子模拟，支持多物种粒子交互，并引入了多种更新核函数，带来了类似**Particle Life**的复杂行为模式。该项目受Alexander Mordvintsev等人的**Particle Lenia**研究启发，使用**Three.js**和**WebGPU**技术实现。文章简要说明了粒子在能量场中的运动规律，即粒子通过最小化排斥力和最大化生长力来移动，从而产生复杂的行为模式。文中还提供了源代码链接和模拟演示，鼓励读者自行探索。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Particle Lenia项目的实现、使用及其视觉效果

不同观点：
• sitkack：认为Slackermanz创建的离散版本MNCA是Lenia的前身，并对该项目的起源进行了补充介绍，提供了相关链接。
• lbeckman314：对Particle Lenia的3D示例表示赞赏，并详细提供了在Chrome上运行该示例的具体步骤和代码链接。
• imiric：被Lenia的视觉效果吸引，但提到在文章底部未找到相关可视化内容，仅看到视频和图片库，尽管已启用WebGPU。
• brianberns：表示对Particle Lenia的赞赏，并分享了自己创建的在线交互版本的链接。
• CraftingLinks：解释了Particle Lenia的移植过程，使用了Three.js中的计算着色器以及（尚未正式发布的）Three.js着色语言（TSL）。

44470447.article_content:
Particle Lenia Deluxe Edition.
Lenia
is a family of cellular automata that produces lifelike behaviors and patterns, first described in the seminal paper by Bert Wang-Chak Chan.
This project is heavily inspired by the original
Particle Lenia
research by Alexander Mordvintsev et al., which implemented a particle-based version of Lenia in Python and
JAX
.
Recognizing the importance of scale (number of particles) for simulation dynamics and iteration times for rapid pattern exploration,
I ported the simulation to the GPU and made it 3D. I also added several update kernels in addition to the original Gaussian one and programmed in
support for multi-species particle simulations which opens up a whole new breed of Mathematical Lifeforms, some that behave very reminiscent to critters found in
Particle Life
.
This port was achieved using compute shaders within
Three.js
and the (still unofficial)
Three.js Shading Language (TSL)
.
You can explore the Particle Lenia universe yourself at the bottom of this post
on the condition that your browser supports
WebGPU
and you have a graphics card with enough muscle to crunch the numbers.
The source code for the Particle Lenia implementation can be found
here
, go wild.
A too short intro to Energy Fields and Particles in Particle Lenia
The
energy field
is defined as
where
is the
repulsion field
and
the
growth field
(typically generated by two different convolution kernels). Particles follow the motion law
i.e.
they drift toward lower energy by simultaneously minimizing repulsion
and maximizing growth
. The rich behaviors you see are purely emergent from these local interactions and, to a lesser extent, the choice of kernels (the Mexican-Hat kernel is a personal favorite).
If you’re interested in the math, I encourage you to read the exposition in the original
Particle Lenia paper
.
It only requires that you understand what a ‘gradient’ is (ask an LLM) and how to apply the chain-rule for finding the differential equations.

data.title: Ceramic: A cross-platform and open-source 2D framework in Haxe
data.author: -yukari
data.article_summary: Ceramic利用Haxe编程语言的跨平台特性，实现了一次编写代码，即可将其转译为C++、JavaScript或C#。这使得应用能够原生导出到多个平台，包括Windows、Mac、Linux、iOS、Android、HTML5/WebGL，甚至集成到Unity项目中。Ceramic为开发者提供了高效的跨平台开发解决方案。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Haxe语言的优缺点及其应用场景

不同观点：
• gr4vityWall认为Haxe是一个有趣的语言，尤其赞赏其内置的imgui支持。他还指出，如果15年前Haxe专注于改善工具和人体工学以支持Web开发而非游戏开发，它有可能取代TypeScript的地位。
• themerone承认Haxe语言本身不错，但认为它未能兑现其承诺。特别指出其API在不同后端之间不够一致，导致难以在复杂应用中跨后端使用。
• mattigames提到Haxe缺乏移动输入的例子，而在当今游戏开发中，移动平台是主要的游戏平台，这可能是一个不足。

补充讨论：
• gr4vityWall对Haxe在游戏开发和Web开发中的潜力进行了比较，暗示其在Web开发领域的未实现潜力。
• themerone的评论指出了一个技术上的限制，即Haxe在多后端开发中的一致性问题，这可能影响其在大型项目中的实用性。
• mattigames关注Haxe在移动游戏开发中的实际应用例子不足，这可能影响开发者对该语言的接受度。

争议焦点：Haxe在多平台开发中的实际效果和工具支持是否足够成熟。这涉及到其API一致性问题（themerone的观点）以及在移动平台上的应用例子缺乏问题（mattigames的观点）。

data.title: Rules of good writing (2007)
data.author: santiviquez
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：关于写作风格、简洁性、以及不同语言和文体对写作的影响的讨论。

不同观点：
• mtlynch: 认为读者理解“the boy hit the ball”比“the ball was hit by the boy”更快，因为英语中主语→动词→宾语的结构更常见。但怀疑这种理解方式可能仅适用于英语，并不一定适用于所有语言。
• kens: 提到大多数写作指南都是Strunk & White的复述，但推荐了"Style: Toward Clarity and Grace"作为更高级的选择。
• wduquette: 对纠正一个18年前的评论感到无奈，认为纠正过时的观点是徒劳的。
• raincole: 指出写作规则具有情境性，不同领域（如科技创业和文学杂志）对写作风格的要求不同，没有绝对的规则。
• CharlesW: 认为Strunk的“省略不必要的词”是好的商业写作建议，但对于想要深入写作 craft 的人，推荐Stephen King的《On Writing》。
• GGByron: 强调简洁不仅仅是去掉多余的词，还包括避免陈词滥调。认为Adams没有引用Orwell，也没有解释清楚概念。
• djoldman: 赞同简洁性，引用Hemingway的观点，认为应该删减句子中的多余词汇。
• irchans: 纠正mtlynch的评论，指出应该是“主语（the boy）在动作（the hitting）之前”，而不是“对象（the boy）”。
• Labov: 认为简洁的写作建议适用于博客作者和记者，但不一定适合小说家或诗人。
• m0llusk: 幽默地提到rap音乐的兴起是否与写作简洁性有关。
• jbreckmckye: 认为清晰和简短虽然是好的开始，但并不足够，还需要更多的修饰和内容。引用Calvin Coolidge的例子来说明过于简短的弊端。
• lutusp: 质疑“好写作的规则”这一说法，认为标题本身是一个词汇错误，应该关注的是选择而不是价值。提到Strunk & White的影响，并幽默地表示自己“煮掉”了这本书，只剩下“让每个词都有价值”这一点。
• CalChris: 认为Adams给出了好的建议，但过于简洁的写作可能不会让人记住作者。

补充讨论：
• 关于写作简洁性和规则的普遍适用性存在争议，不同文体和领域对写作风格的要求不同。
• 对Strunk & White的观点和影响有不同的评价，有人推荐更高级的写作指南。
• 评论中还涉及到对过时评论的无奈，以及对写作建议的幽默调侃。

争议焦点：
• 写作简洁性的适用范围和程度，特别是在不同文体和语言中的应用。

44490490.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：关于写作风格、简洁性、以及不同语言和文体对写作的影响的讨论。

不同观点：
• mtlynch: 认为读者理解“the boy hit the ball”比“the ball was hit by the boy”更快，因为英语中主语→动词→宾语的结构更常见。但怀疑这种理解方式可能仅适用于英语，并不一定适用于所有语言。
• kens: 提到大多数写作指南都是Strunk & White的复述，但推荐了"Style: Toward Clarity and Grace"作为更高级的选择。
• wduquette: 对纠正一个18年前的评论感到无奈，认为纠正过时的观点是徒劳的。
• raincole: 指出写作规则具有情境性，不同领域（如科技创业和文学杂志）对写作风格的要求不同，没有绝对的规则。
• CharlesW: 认为Strunk的“省略不必要的词”是好的商业写作建议，但对于想要深入写作 craft 的人，推荐Stephen King的《On Writing》。
• GGByron: 强调简洁不仅仅是去掉多余的词，还包括避免陈词滥调。认为Adams没有引用Orwell，也没有解释清楚概念。
• djoldman: 赞同简洁性，引用Hemingway的观点，认为应该删减句子中的多余词汇。
• irchans: 纠正mtlynch的评论，指出应该是“主语（the boy）在动作（the hitting）之前”，而不是“对象（the boy）”。

• m0llusk: 幽默地提到rap音乐的兴起是否与写作简洁性有关。

• lutusp: 质疑“好写作的规则”这一说法，认为标题本身是一个词汇错误，应该关注的是选择而不是价值。提到Strunk & White的影响，并幽默地表示自己“煮掉”了这本书，只剩下“让每个词都有价值”这一点。

New Release
Xenharmlib 0.3.0 has just been released.
Find out what’s new
Welcome to xenharmlib’s documentation!
¶
Xenharmonic (adj.):
Pertaining to music which sounds unlike
that composed in the familiar 12 tone equal-tempered scale.
—
Ivor Darreg
Xenharmlib is a generalized music theory library that supports traditional
Western and non-western harmonic systems, unconventional microtonal and
macrotonal tunings, diatonic and posttonal set theory and non-standard
notations.

Audience & Design Philosophy
¶
Xenharmlib is targeted at composers and researchers who already have
basic knowledge in python programming.
Xenharmlib does
not
aim to be a score composition tool, sequencer,
or synthesizer (however it is possible to build such things on top of
it). Rather it wants to provide a toolset for exploring different
concepts of harmonic relations with a scientific focus.
Xenharmlib is object-oriented but mostly designed around functional
programming principles: Objects are considered immutable and methods
do not alter internal states but return modified versions of the
original object.
Features
¶
A selection of things supported by xenharmlib:
Equal division tunings (e.g. Western, Modern Arabic, Turkish Makam,
Bohlen-Pierce, Wendy Carlos’ Gamma Scale)
Western notation (including interval naming)
Up/Down notation (a superset of Western notation)
Analysis of intervals, scales, and their relations to one another
Group theoretical analysis (integer pitches, pitch classes, etc)
Interval sequence pattern matching
Modulation suggestions for arbitrary key changes
Basic posttonal analysis (normal & prime form calculations, inversion, etc)
Roadmap
¶
A list of planned features (not necessarily in chronological order):
Templates for Western music
Plugin interface for score rendering backends
Advanced posttonal analysis (interval vectors, z-Relations, Forte numbers)
Rothenberg propriety and interval matrices
MOS scale generation utilities
Just Intonation and prime limit tunings
Extended Helmholtz-Ellis JI Pitch Notation
Odd Limit Tunings
Arel-Ezgi-Uzdilek notation
License
¶
Xenharmlib is released under the
GNU Public License v3
.
You can find the source code hosted on
Gitlab.com
Acknowledgments
¶
Thanks to
Kite Giedraitis
and
Lumi Pakkanen
and everyone else on the
Xenharmonic Alliance Discord who was patient with me when I was
struggling to implement UpDownNotation.
Support and Contact
¶
If you want to ask for a new feature or report a bug, take it to the
Gitlab issue page
.
In case you just wanna chat with the maintainer: I often hang around on
the
Xenharmonic Alliance Discord
under the name
@retooth

data.title: Bulgaria to join euro area on 1 January 2026
data.author: toomuchtodo
data.article_summary: 保加利亚将于2026年1月1日加入欧元区，汇率定为1.95583列弗兑1欧元。保加利亚于2020年加入欧盟汇率机制（ERM II），其货币汇率自那时起一直保持在该水平。自2020年10月1日起，欧洲央行（ECB）开始直接监管保加利亚的四家主要金融机构，并 oversight 其他13家较小机构。保加利亚在ERM II中的表现符合加入欧元区的趋同标准，ECB和保加利亚国民银行将共同监控其汇率直至2026年。媒体咨询联系人：Benoit Deeg，电话：+49 172 1683 704。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：欧元区的扩张及其影响

不同观点：
• 支持欧元扩张的观点：
   - 欧元作为单一货币已经成功运行了26年，并且仍在扩展（decimalenough）。
   - 欧元帮助各国以较低利率获得贷款，减少货币市场不稳定的风险（16th_hop）。
   - 欧元在减少美元主导地位方面具有积极意义（v5v3）。

• 对欧元扩张持怀疑或批评的观点：
   - 担心欧元区国家经济实力不同，统一货币和中央管理并不理想（v5v3）。
   - 希腊的教训：加入欧元区可能导致经济困境，特别是无法通过货币贬值来缓解经济问题（ktsangop）。
   - 引入欧元可能导致物价显著上涨，类似情况曾在其他国家发生过（theodric, jmyeet, storus）。

• 对欧元实际影响的讨论：
   - 欧元在日常生活中并未带来太大变化，但其象征意义和政治意义重大（SwtCyber）。
   - 一些用户担心旅游业的发展可能导致地方独特性的丧失（keiferski）。

补充讨论：
• 关于欧元引入后物价变化的研究不足，历史上的转换如德国和法国的经验值得参考（jmyeet）。
• 欧元购买力下降的问题，以及通过电视广告宣传引入欧元的必要性受到质疑（ingohelpinger）。

争议焦点：
• 欧元引入对经济的长远影响，特别是对新加入国家如保加利亚的经济影响存在争议。一方面是经济整合和贷款成本降低的优势，另一方面是物价上涨和经济自主性丧失的风险。

44505308.article_content:
PRESS RELEASE
Bulgaria to join euro area on 1 January 2026
8 July 2025
Conversion rate of lev fixed at 1.95583 = EUR 1
Bulgaria joined the ERM II in 2020
Bulgarian banks supervised by ECB since 2020
Today the Council of the European Union formally approved the accession of Bulgaria to the euro area on 1 January 2026 and determined a Bulgarian lev conversion rate of 1.95583 per euro. This is the current central rate of the lev in the Exchange Rate Mechanism (ERM II), which the currency joined on 10 July 2020. The European Central Bank (ECB) and Българска народна банка (Bulgarian National Bank) agreed to monitor developments in the Bulgarian lev against the euro on the foreign exchange market until 1 January 2026.
With the entry into force of the
close cooperation framework between the ECB and Българска народна банка (Bulgarian National Bank)
, the ECB has been responsible for directly supervising four significant institutions and overseeing 13 less significant institutions in Bulgaria since 1 October 2020.
For media queries, please contact
Benoit Deeg
, tel.: +49 172 1683 704.
Notes
The agreement to monitor the lev is in the context of ERM II. Participation in ERM II and observance of the normal fluctuation margins for at least the last two years is one of the convergence criteria to be fulfilled ahead of euro area accession.
The conversion rate of the lev is set by way of an amendment to Regulation (EC) No 2866/98, which will become effective on 1 January 2026.

   - 欧元作为单一货币已经成功运行了26年，并且仍在扩展（decimalenough）。
   - 欧元帮助各国以较低利率获得贷款，减少货币市场不稳定的风险（16th_hop）。
   - 欧元在减少美元主导地位方面具有积极意义（v5v3）。

• 对欧元扩张持怀疑或批评的观点：
   - 担心欧元区国家经济实力不同，统一货币和中央管理并不理想（v5v3）。
   - 希腊的教训：加入欧元区可能导致经济困境，特别是无法通过货币贬值来缓解经济问题（ktsangop）。
   - 引入欧元可能导致物价显著上涨，类似情况曾在其他国家发生过（theodric, jmyeet, storus）。

• 对欧元实际影响的讨论：
   - 欧元在日常生活中并未带来太大变化，但其象征意义和政治意义重大（SwtCyber）。
   - 一些用户担心旅游业的发展可能导致地方独特性的丧失（keiferski）。

补充讨论：
• 关于欧元引入后物价变化的研究不足，历史上的转换如德国和法国的经验值得参考（jmyeet）。
• 欧元购买力下降的问题，以及通过电视广告宣传引入欧元的必要性受到质疑（ingohelpinger）。

争议焦点：
• 欧元引入对经济的长远影响，特别是对新加入国家如保加利亚的经济影响存在争议。一方面是经济整合和贷款成本降低的优势，另一方面是物价上涨和经济自主性丧失的风险。

data.title: What goes wrong when we write ghazals in English
data.author: ishita159
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：诗歌翻译，尤其是乌尔都语诗歌形式“嘎扎尔”翻译的挑战和本质。

不同观点：
• [lubujackson] 认为翻译诗歌本质上是变革性的，翻译过程中需要做出取舍，甚至要提升或创造某些元素。他提出翻译的目标是传递源材料的某些核心元素，而不是追求绝对的准确性。为了保留概念和情感，他放弃了押韵，因为这会导致与语言限制的冲突。
• [microflash] 认为将嘎扎尔翻译成英语本质上是不准确的，更准确的描述应是“准确的诠释”，因为这始终是一种解读。他强调语言和文化的差异会导致即使是并列阅读原文和译文，也会有显著或微妙的文化差异。此外，他指出嘎扎尔与伊斯兰文化圈无关，许多著名嘎扎尔诗人并不遵循伊斯兰教义。
• [boredgargoyle] 作为一个刚尝试翻译的人，感到在英语中遵循嘎扎尔的规则很混乱，表达了对翻译困难的理解。

补充讨论：
• [ishita159] 提到《The Oxford India Ghalib》一书，该书将原文和译文并列呈现，暗示这种双语版本可能为翻译的挑战提供解决方案或参考。

争议焦点：
• 翻译的目标和本质：是追求准确传递所有细节，还是允许诠释和创造以传达核心情感和概念。
• 嘎扎尔与伊斯兰文化的关系：对嘎扎尔是否属于伊斯兰文化圈的不同看法。
• 翻译中的文化与语言差异如何影响最终译文的理解和感受。

data.title: RapidRAW: A non-destructive and GPU-accelerated RAW image editor
data.author: l8rlump
data.article_summary: RapidRAW是一款现代、高性能、非破坏性的RAW图像编辑器，支持GPU加速，体积小巧（不到30MB），适用于Windows、macOS和Linux。它由CyberTimon开发，旨在为摄影工作流提供高效工具，同时加深对React和Rust的理解。其核心功能包括GPU加速处理、AI驱动的遮罩、广泛的RAW格式支持、非破坏性编辑、32位精度、专业的调整工具（如色调控制、颜色分级、细节增强等）、以及高效的图像库管理。近期更新包括增强的AI功能、图像评分过滤器、预设覆盖、以及对ComfyUI的初步集成。项目采用AGPL-3.0许可证。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：关于开源RAW图像处理工具“RawTherapee”的评价与讨论，涉及功能、性能、用户体验、技术细节等方面。

不同观点：
• **对RawTherapee的积极评价**：
   - strogonoff：赞赏其色彩科学准确性、可脚本化、丰富的文档（RawPedia），尤其适合对技术细节感兴趣的用户。同时也指出其缺少HDR输出的问题。
   - miladyincontrol：希望加入亮度蒙版功能，认为这对RAW编辑非常重要。对现有的AI主体蒙版功能表示赞赏。
   - ioma8：表示有兴趣参与该项目的开发。

• **性能问题的反馈**：
   - polishdude20：在M1 Mac上运行时，初次加载卡顿严重，虽然之后有所改善，但整体不够流畅。
   - vsviridov：在Windows 10和AMD RX 6900 XT上运行时，处理6000x4000的DNG文件速度很慢，调整参数时延迟明显。

• **对元数据和跨平台支持的关注**：
   - pradn：关心元数据的存储方式，尤其是是否为开放格式，以便在不同程序间迁移编辑内容。同时提到不愿每月付费订阅Lightroom。
   - rkagerer：询问系统要求和最低操作系统版本。

• **对用户界面和技术实现的讨论**：
   - dxroshan：认为基于网页的图像编辑界面不好，会慢且资源消耗大。
   - Springtime：赞赏README中的视觉概览，但指出GIF文件过大，建议使用视频代替以提高加载速度。
   - bjelkeman-again：询问Mac代码签名的难度。

• **对RAW和Bitmap区别的疑问**：
   - brcmthrowaway：询问RAW和Bitmap的区别，特别提到Bitmap是否无压缩。

补充讨论：
• 一些用户对RawTherapee的技术细节表现出浓厚兴趣（如色彩科学、元数据处理、默认相机和镜头配置文件等），而另一些用户则更关注实际使用中的性能问题（如卡顿、延迟）。
• 关于跨平台支持和系统要求的问题也被多次提及，显示出用户群体对软件兼容性和易用性的关注。
• 部分用户对RawTherapee与商业软件（如Capture One、Lightroom）的对比，反映出开源与商业软件之间的选择争议。

RapidRAW
A beautiful, non-destructive, and GPU-accelerated RAW image editor built with performance in mind.
RapidRAW is a modern, high-performance alternative to Adobe Lightroom. It delivers a feature-rich, beautiful editing experience in a lightweight package (under 30MB) for Windows, macOS, and Linux.
I developed this project as a personal challenge at the age of 18. My goal was to create a high-performance tool for my own photography workflow while deepening my understanding of both React and Rust, with the support from Google Gemini.
Have fun!

Key Features
Core Editing Engine
GPU-Accelerated Processing:
All image adjustments are processed on the GPU using a custom WGSL shader for rapid feedback.
Masking:
Instantly create precise masks with AI subject and foreground detection. Combine with traditional Brush, Linear, and Radial masks for great control.
Generative Edits:
Remove objects or add new elements with text prompts. Each edit creates a non-destructive patch layer, powered by an optional ComfyUI backend.
Full RAW Support:
Supports a wide range of RAW camera formats thanks to rawler.
Non-Destructive Workflow:
All edits are stored in a
.rrdata
sidecar file, leaving your original images untouched.
32-bit Precision:
Ensures high-quality adjustments without banding or data loss.
Professional Grade Adjustments
Tonal Controls:
Exposure, Contrast, Highlights, Shadows, Whites, and Blacks.
Tone Curves:
Full control over Luma, Red, Green, and Blue channels.
Color Grading:
Temperature, Tint, Vibrance, Saturation, and a full HSL color mixer.
Detail Enhancement:
Sharpening, Clarity, Structure, and Noise Reduction.
Effects:
Dehaze, Vignette, and realistic Film Grain simulation.
Transform Tools:
Crop with aspect ratio locking, Rotate, and Flip.
Library & Workflow
Image Library:
Effortlessly sort, rate, and manage your entire photo collection for a streamlined and efficient workflow.
Folder Management:
Integrated folder tree, create, rename, and delete folders directly within the app.
File Operations:
Copy, move, and duplicate images and their associated edits.
Filmstrip View:
Quickly navigate between all the images in your current folder while editing.
Batch Operations:
Save significant time by applying a consistent set of adjustments or exporting entire batches of images simultaneously.
EXIF Data Viewer:
Gain insights by inspecting the complete metadata from your camera, including shutter speed, aperture, ISO, and lens information.
Productivity & UI
Preset System:
Create, save, import, and export your favorite looks.

data.title: Frame of preference A history of Mac settings, 1984–2004
data.author: K7PJP
data.article_summary: 本文探讨了1984年至2004年间Mac电脑设置界面的演变历史。作者作为一名设计师，虽然按理应不喜欢设置选项，但作为用户却对其充满兴趣，并每年设立“设置日”来研究软件中的选项和开关。文章特别提到1984年由Susan Kare设计的Mac控制面板，这一设计至今仍被提及。最初的控制面板简洁直观，包含了动画和早期GUI实验元素，如滑块和步进器。有趣的是，当时团队对桌面定制功能存在分歧，担心用户会创建“丑陋的桌面图案”。尽管存在一些小瑕疵和操作缓慢的问题，早期控制面板依然充满魅力。到了1986年，随着时间推移，许多原有的 charm 逐渐消失。文章通过回顾Mac设置界面的发展，展示了这台机器早期历史和设计挑战。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：评论围绕一篇关于Mac电脑和操作系统模拟器的文章展开，涉及技术实现、用户体验、怀旧情感以及对现代系统设置的批评。

不同观点：
• [赞赏技术实现] 
  - thristian: 对文章中实时互动的模拟器感到惊叹，尤其是可以模拟不同操作并追踪用户行为。
  - cadamsdotcom: 赞赏作者对网页和Mac的热爱，认为这是对技术力量的致敬。
  - rezmason: 对模拟器内事件的实现方式感到好奇，并探讨了像素分析的技术细节。

• [对设备识别问题的讨论]
  - dmitshur: 对文章中提到“在电脑上打开”感到困惑，因为他的Surface Pro X被识别为非电脑，后来作者添加了额外说明以解决此问题。

• [怀旧情感]
  - tobr: 提到文章作者曾参与过类似的项目，引发对过去近20年的感慨。
  - jfvinueza: 回忆起PowerBook G4，并对文章和网站表示赞赏。
  - vintagedave: 怀念早期Mac OS的控制面板设计，认为现在的系统设置缺乏关怀和个性。

• [对现代系统设置的批评]
  - kamel3d: 批评MacOS Ventura的设置界面布局混乱，难以找到所需选项。
  - PeterStuer: 认为尽管Apple的设置界面有不一致之处，但Microsoft在Windows 7后的设置管理更加糟糕。

• [设备兼容性问题]
  - pixelatedindex: 希望文章能在iPad Air上运行，但未能实现，不过仍然欣赏文章和网站的设计。

• [用户习惯]
  - nofunsir: 提到自己仍然习惯在文件菜单中寻找“偏好设置”和“退出”选项，反映出对旧有用户界面的依赖。

补充讨论：
- 评论中多次提到对文章和技术实现的赞赏，尤其是实时模拟和怀旧元素的结合。
- 对现代系统设置的批评集中在用户体验和界面设计的变化上。
- 设备识别和兼容性问题引发了一些技术讨论，特别是不同设备和浏览器的识别机制。
- 用户习惯的延续也反映出对界面设计变化的适应问题。

44505171.article_content:
Frame of preference
A history of Mac settings, 1984â2004
As a designer, Iâm meant to dislike settings. As a user, I love them.
Every year I celebrate Settings Day: a day when I take a look at the options and toggles in all the apps I use. I do this out of curiosity â what was added since the last time I looked? â but also because I love this way of getting to know software: peeking under the hood, walking the back alleys, learning what has been tricky or important enough to be equipped with a checkbox.
During the last Settings Day, I had a realization that the totemic 1984 Mac control panel, designed by Susan Kare, is still to this day perhaps the only settings screen ever brought up in casual conversation.
I kept wondering about that screen, and about what happened since then. Turns out, the Mac settings have lived a far more fascinating life than I imagined, have been redesigned many times, and can tell us a lot about the early history and the troubled upbringing of this interesting machine.
Join me on a journey through the first twenty years of Macâs control panels.
1984
Itâs rare when software matches hardware so well.
Even already in 1979, the Macintosh was envisioned as a home appliance akin to a toaster or a TV. This was documented in
one of my favorite memos of all time
. Get the machine out of the box. Leave the screwdriver in the drawer. There is no step three.
Once you do that,
open the Apple menu
, and then
launch the Control Panel
, and you will find a small appliance hiding inside the machine, too. A European appliance, even âÂ outside of the title bar, there are absolutely no words present here.
The Control Panel is a handsome and tight design, put together by Susan Kare as the
last desk accessory
, just weeks before the Macâs announcement. It feels alive, depicting a perhaps surprising amount of movement sometimes via animation, sometimes via comic book-inspired conventions: soundwaves exiting the speaker, menus blinking upon activation, a finger pressing a key, the mouse rolling on the desk. Itâs also a playground of sorts for early GUI experiments: there is an early
slider
here, some
steppers
for date and time, a custom cursor, and a mini map showing a miniature desktop.
The last two are in service of the most contentious addition:
customizing the desktop pattern
. The original Mac team was divided on this one, worrying this would lead to âabominable patternsâ and therefore âugly desktopsâ â an ongoing design challenge for any setting that is not about how something works, but about how something
looks
.
Future, more garish desktop options on computers and eventually smartphones would render these early reservations quaint. This might be the best that the Mac desktop will look for about the next twenty years. But at this moment, it felt serious. The creator of
MacPaint
rebelled and built his app so that any custom background would be drawn over by a default 50% checkerboard anyway. But can you even make an ugly desktop pattern with just 64 black pixels to mess with? Maybeâ¦ The most surprising is the fact that the team also prepared 41 beautiful built-in patterns, but hid them inside this control panel with the only hints how to get them appearing in the manual.
At this point in time, this was the only way you could truly customize your Mac to fit your personality, and itâs nice that it also happens to be one thatâs fun to use, ironically perhaps inspired by MacPaint and its
FatBits
setting.
Other controls might be slightly surprising: out of just ten settings, three are dedicated to motor memory. The two keyboard toggles make sense. Even in the early 1980s, there were keyboards â terminals or electric typewriters â whose repeating style you might have gotten used to. We already knew that once something lodges itself in your fingertips, itâs really hard to override it, even consciously, so it was clever to add customization to work around that.
But the third option is for double clicking that never existed before. There werenât really decades or even years of studies done on mouse usage, either. I imagine the creators felt it was better safe than sorry.
This early Control Panel has been celebrated since, even though there are mistakes here: the inconsistent Chicago 3, the top section being one pixel too short, and an occasional uneven border. The UI, like the whole Mac, is slow and clunky â you can see the panel, the windows, even the menus struggling to be drawn with required haste. (Only the mouse pointer is speedy, and it was
a small miracle
how it got this way.)
For people using this early Mac, this was likely frustrating as hell. Today, it feels like a perfect intro for a new little machine, the best dense collection of pixels this side of
Winamp
. Itâs cute, it gets the job done, and it has tons of charm.
Control Panel embroidery
Stitched and patterned by
gmatom
1986
Two years later, and a lot of that charm is gone. Susan Kare and Steve Jo

data.title: Surfing on a Matchbox (1999)
data.author: TMWNN
data.article_summary: 1999年2月10日，斯坦福大学计算机科学家Vaughan Pratt教授打造了当时世界上最小的网页服务器，仅有火柴盒大小，使用AMD 486-SX处理器、66 MHz CPU、16 MB RAM和闪存，运行简化版Linux系统。该服务器比当时典型的台式电脑小3000倍，旨在展示可穿戴计算机的潜力。Pratt教授成立了可穿戴实验室，致力于将计算机整合进衣物中，并正在开发能识别数字手语的手套"Thumbcode"以解决数据输入问题。未来版本还将增强语音识别能力，并计划开发更强大的信用卡大小的服务器。这一技术展示了嵌入式系统连接互联网的潜力，应用范围广泛。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：技术发展的预测与实际演变，以及学术研究的价值和方向

不同观点：
• NoboruWataya认为，过去的技术预测在某些方面接近现实，但并不完全准确。他指出，虽然便携式计算机的确成为了主流，但并非以当时设想的“特殊手套”形式，而是以智能手机的形式出现。他还提到，尽管当时移动电话已经存在，且部分可以兼容互联网，但智能手机的兴起在当时并不明显。

• em3rgent0rdr对过去互联网早期时代的天真乐观表示感慨，提到当时人们曾期望未来的个人能够拥有并运行自己的网络服务器，而这一愿景并未完全实现。

• revx的评论相对简单，带有幽默感，询问当前世界上最小的网络服务器的记录保持者是什么，这可能是对早期技术预测的一种调侃或兴趣。

• teekert对学术研究的价值提出质疑，认为一些教授的工作可能是在“浪费钱”，并质疑他们是否应更专注于为社会带来实际利益的技术，而不是仅仅从事“酷炫的项目”。

补充讨论：
• teekert的观点引发了对学术研究方向的讨论，反映了部分公众对高薪教授从事非应用性研究的质疑，涉及到科技发展中市场需求与学术自由之间的张力。

• 评论中还隐含了对技术预测不确定性的讨论，尤其是当技术发展受到市场、公司和偶然因素的影响时，预测未来的困难性。

争议焦点：
• 学术研究是否应以直接社会效益为导向，还是应允许自由探索“酷炫的”概念和技术，这是评论中反映的主要争议。

Wednesday, February 10, 1999 Published at 13:05 GMT
Sci/Tech
Surfing on a matchbox
This computer runs a web site
The smallest web server yet has been built and is now running a website.
It is one tenth the size of a Palm Pilot and dwarfed by a typical desktop computer, which is 3,000 times larger.
The matchbox-sized server was built from standard components by Professor Vaughan Pratt, a computer scientist at Stanford University, California.
"It's basically a powerful little computer and we could have set it up for a number of different uses," he said. "But, because most people think of servers as mysterious boxes, located in dark basements, I thought making it into a web server was particularly dramatic."
Computer clothes
The new Stanford web server is one of the first projects from a new Wearables Laboratory that Professor Pratt has started to develop computers that can be incorporated in clothing.
"Put this computer into your shirt pocket, hook it to a wireless modem, and you could carry it around with you," Professor Pratt says.
The tiny computer's vital statistics are:
6.9 x 4.3 x 0.6 cm in size
AMD 486-SX computer,
66 MHz CPU
16 MB RAM
16 MB flash ROM
partial version of RedHat 5.2 Linux operating system
2 watts from a 5V power supply at 100% CPU usage
Professor Pratt believes the biggest obstacle to a truly wearable computer is the lack of an easy, compact way of inputting data. Professor Pratt and doctoral student Greg Defouw are now working on a special glove that can recognize a digital sign language, called Thumbcode.
The talking type
Future versions of the matchbox computer should be powerful enough to run voice recognition software, he says.
The Wearables group is already working on a more powerful server, combining a credit-card-size Pentium motherboard with a new 340 MB hard drive from IBM that is a fraction of an inch thick and less than five centimetres on a side.
The previous world's smallest web server was a custom computer from Phar Lap Software, more than 10 times the size of the new one. The Phar Lap server provides up-to-date local weather data for Cambridge, Massachusetts.
Its purpose is to show how "embedded systems" can connect to the World Wide Web. Embedded systems are computers fitted in devices ranging from refrigerators to lifts to medical instruments.

data.title: Libpostal: C library for parsing/normalizing street addresses around the world
data.author: nateb2022
data.article_summary: libpostal是一个开源的C语言库，用于解析和标准化全球街道地址。它利用统计自然语言处理（NLP）和开放地理数据，目标是理解各种语言的地址格式。该库可以将人类使用的非结构化地址转换为规范形式，便于机器对比和全文索引，特别适用于地图、交通、快递等应用。虽然libpostal本身不是完整的地理编码器，但可以作为预处理步骤，提高国际化地址处理的智能性和一致性。该项目支持Python、Ruby、Go、Java、PHP和NodeJS等多种语言绑定，并提供了详细的安装指南。公司和个人可以通过赞助或捐赠支持该项目的持续发展。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：地址解析和规范化的复杂性及其实现工具（如libpostal）的有效性

不同观点：
• **支持libpostal的观点**：
   - **Ameo**：在之前公司使用libpostal取得了较好的效果，能够相对轻松地将原始地址字符串解析为结构化数据。
   - **alganet**：认为libpostal比正则表达式表现更好。
   - **weinzierl**：提到Google的libphonenumber库在处理国际电话号码上的类似经验，并指出许多公司使用商业服务来进行地址和电话号码的验证和规范化。

• **对地址解析持怀疑态度的观点**：
   - **shakna**：质疑地址标准化的可行性，以自己在澳大利亚的非标准化地址为例，说明实际地址可能不符合常规格式。
   - **jandrese**：指出不同国家和地区的非正式标准和人们的随意性使得地址验证成为一个几乎无法解决的问题。

• **对libpostal的批评和替代建议**：
   - **kerkeslager**：认为地址本质上是无结构的数据，地址解析和规范化库难以有效工作。主张使用搜索库来验证地址是否存在于真实世界的地址数据集中，而不是依赖解析库。
   - **RobinL**：警告不要将libpostal作为地址匹配的主要方法，认为最难解析的地址往往也是最难匹配的，主张结合其他方法。

补充讨论：
• **技术实现和资源需求**：
   - **claytongulick**：指出libpostal需要大量的存储空间和显著的运行时资源，建议将其部署为独立服务。
   
• **其他相关资源和讨论**：
   - **degamad**：提供了之前关于libpostal的讨论链接，帮助扩展阅读。
   - **ttw44**：分享了自己在网页开发中处理地址输入时的困惑和放弃经历。
   - **gorgoiler**：表达了对日常事物编码化的兴趣，提到其他相关项目如tzdata、GNU units等。

争议焦点：
• 地址解析和规范化的可行性及其实际效果，特别是在面对非标准化地址时。

libpostal: international street address NLP
libpostal is a C library for parsing/normalizing street addresses around the world using statistical NLP and open data. The goal of this project is to understand location-based strings in every language, everywhere. For a more comprehensive overview of the research behind libpostal, be sure to check out the (lengthy) introductory blog posts:
Original post
:
Statistical NLP on OpenStreetMap
Follow-up for 1.0 release
:
Statistical NLP on OpenStreetMap: Part 2

Addresses and the locations they represent are essential for any application dealing with maps (place search, transportation, on-demand/delivery services, check-ins, reviews). Yet even the simplest addresses are packed with local conventions, abbreviations and context, making them difficult to index/query effectively with traditional full-text search engines. This library helps convert the free-form addresses that humans use into clean normalized forms suitable for machine comparison and full-text indexing. Though libpostal is not itself a full geocoder, it can be used as a preprocessing step to make any geocoding application smarter, simpler, and more consistent internationally.

Sponsors
If your company is using libpostal, consider asking your organization to sponsor the project. Interpreting what humans mean when they refer to locations is far from a solved problem, and sponsorships help us pursue new frontiers in geospatial NLP. As a sponsor, your company logo will appear prominently on the Github repo page along with a link to your site.

Installation (Mac/Linux)
Before you install, make sure you have the following prerequisites:
On Ubuntu/Debian
sudo apt-get install -y curl build-essential autoconf automake libtool pkg-config
On CentOS/RHEL
sudo yum install curl autoconf automake libtool pkgconfig
On macOS
Install with one command via
MacPorts
:
port install libpostal
Or as follows with
Homebrew
:
brew install curl autoconf automake libtool pkg-config
Then to install the C library:
If you're using an M1 Mac, add
--disable-sse2
to the
./configure
command. This will result in poorer performance but the build will succeed.
git clone https://github.com/openvenues/libpostal
cd libpostal
# skip if installing for the first time
make distclean
./bootstrap.sh
# omit --datadir flag to install data in current directory
./configure --datadir=[...some dir with a few GB of space where a "libpostal" directory exists or can be created/modified...]
make -j4
# For Intel/AMD processors and the default model
./configure --datadir=[...some dir with a few GB of space where a "libpostal" directory exists or can be created/modified...]
# For Apple / ARM cpus and the default model
./configure --datadir=[...some dir with a few GB of space where a "libpostal" directory exists or can be created/modified...] --disable-sse2
# For the improved Senzing model:
./configure --datadir=[...some dir with a few GB of space where a "libpostal" directory exists or can be created/modified...] MODEL=senzing
make -j8
sudo make install
# On Linux it's probably a good idea to run
sudo ldconfig
libpostal has support for pkg-config, so you can use the pkg-config to print the flags needed to link your program against it:
pkg-config --cflags libpostal         # print compiler flags
pkg-config --libs libpostal           # print linker flags
pkg-config --cflags --l
44505610.article_summary: libpostal是一个开源的C语言库，用于解析和标准化全球街道地址。它利用统计自然语言处理（NLP）和开放地理数据，目标是理解各种语言的地址格式。该库可以将人类使用的非结构化地址转换为规范形式，便于机器对比和全文索引，特别适用于地图、交通、快递等应用。虽然libpostal本身不是完整的地理编码器，但可以作为预处理步骤，提高国际化地址处理的智能性和一致性。该项目支持Python、Ruby、Go、Java、PHP和NodeJS等多种语言绑定，并提供了详细的安装指南。公司和个人可以通过赞助或捐赠支持该项目的持续发展。
44505610.comments_summary:

data.title: Ptar: Replacing .tgz for petabyte-scale S3 archives
data.author: vcoisne
data.article_summary: 文章介绍了传统备份工具`.tgz`在面对现代大数据需求时的不足，并推出了一种新的归档工具`.ptar`，由Plakar项目开发。`.tgz`在处理海量数据、多版本控制、完整性验证、加密及云存储（如S3）等方面存在局限，而`.ptar`则提供了自动去重、内置加密、完整性验证、版本控制及直接支持S3等功能，解决了`.tgz`的诸多问题。通过实际示例展示了`.ptar`在处理重复数据时的效率更高，适用于大规模数据备份和存档需求。文章最后提供了`.ptar`工具的下载和使用方法，并指出其特别适合冗余数据较多的场景。
data.comments_summary:

不同观点：

44490213.article_content:
Julien Mangeard
Co-Founder @ Plakar Korp
Hi, Iâm Julien, co-founder of Plakar.
Before we built this, I spent years as an engineer and later as a manager of infra teams. We handled backups, compliance, and recovery.
In every place, startups, big companies, regulated sectors, I saw the same routine:
tar -czf archive.tgz /some/folder
We all love that command. But in 2025, it can cause trouble.
Whatâs changed since
.tgz
was invented
Back when tar came out in 1979 or even gzip came out in 1994, things were simple:
Data was small, just a few megabytes.
Storage was local and trusted.
Versioning was not a big deal.
Archives ran in one pass, so you had to decompress everything to get one file.
Now none of that fits our needs.
Over the years data grew huge, like terabytes of logs or model checkpoints. We rely on multiâcore work to finish weeks of processing in minutes. We must assume zero trust, so we need proof no one changed anything. Data sits in S3 and other object stores, not on a local disk. We need to track versions and snapshots. And we often want a single file instantly, without waiting for a full decompress.
Plain old
.tgz
was never made for this.
Why
.tgz
does not work with S3
On a traditional POSIX filesystem, many teams run periodic .tgz snapshots of local disks or NFS shares.
By contrast, S3 buckets are rarely backed up (a rather short-sighted approach for mission-critical cloud data), and even one-off archives are rarely done.
If you want to archive an S3 bucket with
tar
and
gzip
, you:
Download everything to your machine (generating storage cost and/or storage cost).
Run tar.
Maybe encrypt separately.
Calculate checksums by hand.
Upload back your archive somewhere else.
Then, if you need to prove integrity or restore just one file, youâre stuck.
.tgz
canât help.
This process is slow, error-prone, and costly. It does not scale to large datasets or S3 buckets.
What we needed instead
We realized we needed an archive that could:
remove duplicate data automatically to limit storage and transfer costs
encrypt by default to protect sensitive data
store snapshots and history
check integrity with cryptography
talk to S3 and other object stores directly
let you restore parts of an archive on demand
That led us to create Plakar for Backup, it’s storage engine Kloset and now
.ptar
the flat file version of Kloset.
How
.ptar
works
Instead of a simple byte stream, a
.ptar
archive is a selfâcontained, contentâaddressed container.
Here is what it gives you:
deduplication: identical chunks stored once, even across snapshots
builtâin encryption: no extra step
tamper evidence: any change breaks the archive
versioning: keep many snapshots easily
S3 native: one command to archive a bucket
partial restores and browsing: pick a file without unpacking it all
fast targeted restores: grab one file in seconds
A simple example
Suppose I have 11 GB in my Documents and two copies of the same folder:
$ du -sh ~/Documents
11G     /Users/julien/Documents
$ tar -czf test.tgz ~/Documents ~/Documents
Result: about 22 GB compressed.
With
.ptar
:
$ plakar ptar -plaintext -o test.ptar ~/Documents ~/Documents
Result: about 8 GB. Why?
.ptar
sees the duplicate folder once.
In many real-world datasets, a large amount of data is actually redundant: multiple copies, backups, archives, or repeated files across folders. Traditional tools like tar compress everything, even duplicates, which unnecessarily increases the size of the archive. .ptar works differently: it automatically detects and removes duplicates, so each unique chunk is stored only once, no matter how many times it appears. That is why, in the example above, .ptar produces a much smaller archive than .tgz. At large scale, the space savings become significant.
When
.tgz
still makes sense
I admit,
.tgz
is everywhere:
It runs almost anywhere, no dependencies.
It is great for small, throwaway archives.
But when you need trust, speed, and scale,
.ptar
is built for 2025.
Try
.ptar
Get the dev build:
$ go install github.com/PlakarKorp/plakar@v1.0.3-devel.c7a66f1
Then:
archive a folder:
$ plakar ptar -o backup.ptar ~/Documents
archive an S3 bucket:
$ plakar ptar -o backup.ptar s3://my-bucket
list contents:
$ plakar at backup.ptar ls
restore files:
$ plakar at backup.ptar restore -to ./restore /Documents/config.yaml
inspect one file:
$ plakar at backup.ptar cat snapshotid:/path/to/file
mount a UI:
$ plakar at backup.ptar ui
About
.ptar
and Plakar
.ptar
is part of Plakar, our openâsource backup engine for immutable, deduplicated, and encrypted data. It is in the Plakar CLI today, and soon will ship as a standalone binary if you only need archiving.
The code is open source, so feel free to contribute or give feedback.
.ptar
and Plakar are doing the biggest difference on datasets with lots of redundancy, such as:
Backups with multiple versions of the same files or folders
Email, photo, or document archives containing duplicates
S3 buckets with snapshots, backups, or files shared

data.title: Swahili on the Road
data.author: Thevet
data.article_summary: 文章探讨了斯瓦希里语如何成为东非通用语言的过程及其重要性。斯瓦希里语的传播始于19世纪中叶，随着象牙和奴隶贸易的扩大，沿海的商路将其带入内陆市场，使其成为地区通用语。19世纪后期，欧洲传教士对斯瓦希里语进行了拉丁字母标准化，为后来的殖民行政和现代标准斯瓦希里语奠定了基础。1954年，坦噶尼喀非洲民族联盟（TANU）采用斯瓦希里语作为独立运动语言，朱利叶斯·尼雷尔通过演讲推广该语言，使其在独立后的坦桑尼亚成为国家建设的核心。尼雷尔提出的“乌贾马”哲学，强调家庭和社区精神，进一步巩固了斯瓦希里语在国家事务中的地位。到2021年，联合国教科文组织将7月7日定为世界斯瓦希里语日，标志其全球影响力。如今，斯瓦希里语在东非及其他地区广泛使用，但也对其他本地语言构成挑战。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：斯瓦希里语言和文化的多重历史根源，以及其在东非的发展和影响。

不同观点：
• [pazimzadeh] 引用了一项基因研究，强调中世纪斯瓦希里海岸居民的非洲与波斯祖先的混合，并指出这一发现与历史文献《基尔瓦编年史》中的记载相符。该研究还提到，波斯对斯瓦希里语言的影响有限，仅有约3%的词汇来自波斯语，但具体来源不明。

• [georgeg] 以东非人的身份回应，认为文章未充分探讨斯瓦希里语言在东非历史中的重要性。他指出，斯瓦希里不仅是坦桑尼亚的官方语言，还在更广泛的东非地区（从索马里到莫桑比克）作为贸易语言使用了几千年。他还强调斯瓦希里语言的混合特性，包括班图、阿拉伯语以及葡萄牙语借词，并认为将斯瓦希里的成功仅归因于坦桑尼亚是短视的。

补充讨论：
• [callistus] 对文章表示感谢，特别提到尼雷尔（坦桑尼亚前总统）在斯瓦希里语言推广中的作用。

• [muragekibicho] 提到无法访问文章链接，可能由于技术问题（如网站宕机或地理封锁），这引发了对信息获取不平等的潜在关注。

争议焦点：
• 斯瓦希里语言成功的核心原因：[georgeg] 反对将斯瓦希里语言的成功仅归因于坦桑尼亚，强调其在更广泛的东非地区的历史和文化重要性。

• 波斯对斯瓦希里语言的影响：[pazimzadeh] 引用研究表明波斯基因和词汇对斯瓦希里有影响，但[georgeg] 的回应隐含了对这种单一文化影响解释的质疑，强调了斯瓦希里语言的多源性。

44505359.article_content:
Behind the Times
Swahili on the Road
How did Swahili become an East African lingua franca? It was not by accident.
Morgan J. Robinson
| Published in
History Today
Volume 75 Issue 7 July 2025
I
n March 1960 Julius Nyerere – then leader of the Tanganyika African National Union (TANU) – sat down with former first lady Eleanor Roosevelt on her roundtable discussion programme
Prospects of Mankind
. The topic was ‘Africa: A Revolution in Haste’. Although he found himself in a sympathetic circle of interlocutors, Nyerere was asked to defend the ‘readiness’ of African peoples for independence. Good-humoured but resolute, he replied: ‘If you come into my house and steal my jacket, don’t then ask me whether I am ready for my jacket. The jacket was mine, you had no right at all to take it from me … I may not look as smart in it as you look in it, but it’s mine.’ With a simple analogy, Nyerere swept aside the argument that decolonisation was happening too quickly. And though this defence was delivered in composed and commanding English – the language of his degrees at Makerere College in Uganda and Edinburgh University – the language that Nyerere championed at home was Swahili.
In 2021 UNESCO designated 7 July as World Kiswahili Language Day. Swahili is the first African language to be given such a distinction. The date was chosen to mark the decision made by TANU in 1954 to adopt Swahili as the language of its independence movement. Founded by Nyerere two days earlier on 5 July 1954, TANU was Tanganyika’s nationalist party. Over the course of the 1950s TANU demanded – and ultimately achieved – independence, Tanganyika becoming self-governing under the British Crown in 1961, and a full republic with Nyerere as president the following year. At his independence address in December 1961, Nyerere thanked Queen Elizabeth II in English; henceforth, the nation would be built with Swahili.
On the road
Swahili’s centrality in independent Tanganyika was not inevitable. For centuries, it was just one of the region’s more than 120 languages, its speakers concentrated along the Indian Ocean (or, ‘Swahili’) coast. But in the mid-19th century, as demand for ivory and enslaved people expanded, local trade routes in central Africa became incorporated into a global network centred around the Indian Ocean. Caravan routes carried Swahili from coastal ports to interior market towns as an East African lingua franca.
The 19th century also brought orthographic changes to Swahili. Written for centuries with a modified version of the Arabic script, by the middle of the century Swahili’s European partisans had begun the slow process of its Latin standardisation. Starting in 1864, schools run by the Universities’ Mission to Central Africa on Zanzibar took in formerly enslaved children and produced a series of handbooks that, decades later, would be adopted by the British colonial regime as the basis of its administrative Swahili. This established the foundation for the language that is now taught in East Africa and beyond as Standard Swahili, or Kiswahili Sanifu.
As the UN recognised in 2021, Swahili today is a global force, spoken (in all its varieties) by more than 200 million people. It is a national or official language in Tanzania, Kenya, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Rwanda, and Uganda, as well as a working language of the African Union, the East African Community, and the Southern African Development Community. Such is Swahili’s postcolonial force that it has been described by the linguist John Mugane as a ‘linguistic tsunami’, a behemoth the success of which has come at the expense of other East African languages such as Chagga, Sukuma, Bondei, and Zaramo. How did Swahili come to inhabit this powerful position?
Ujamaa
Following the establishment of TANU in 1954, Nyerere and his fellow organisers crisscrossed Tanganyika territory, delivering speeches and encouraging people to join the movement. Addressing his audiences in Swahili, Nyerere later remembered requiring an interpreter on only three occasions (in the Mwanza region near Lake Victoria, for example, Sukuma was found to be more effective than Swahili). TANU made the language central to the fight for independence and, following its achievement, to Tanganyikan nation building. (The country officially became the Republic of Tanzania after the 1964 union with Zanzibar.)
Swahili’s importance was implicit in the philosophy which Nyerere chose to guide Tanzania’s postcolonial path, the concept of ujamaa. A Swahili word meaning ‘familyhood’, it is often glossed as ‘African socialism’. In a 1962 essay, ‘Ujamaa: The Basis of African Socialism’, Nyerere described the ideals embedded within the term: ‘We, in Africa, have no more need of being “converted” to socialism than we have of being “taught” democracy. Both are rooted in our own past.’ The basic unit of the family, and the care that one took for its members, was to be extended to the nation, the continent, and, indeed, to ‘the who
44505359.article_summary: 文章探讨了斯瓦希里语如何成为东非通用语言的过程及其重要性。斯瓦希里语的传播始于19世纪中叶，随着象牙和奴隶贸易的扩大，沿海的商路将其带入内陆市场，使其成为地区通用语。19世纪后期，欧洲传教士对斯瓦希里语进行了拉丁字母标准化，为后来的殖民行政和现代标准斯瓦希里语奠定了基础。1954年，坦噶尼喀非洲民族联盟（TANU）采用斯瓦希里语作为独立运动语言，朱利叶斯·尼雷尔通过演讲推广该语言，使其在独立后的坦桑尼亚成为国家建设的核心。尼雷尔提出的“乌贾马”哲学，强调家庭和社区精神，进一步巩固了斯瓦希里语在国家事务中的地位。到2021年，联合国教科文组织将7月7日定为世界斯瓦希里语日，标志其全球影响力。如今，斯瓦希里语在东非及其他地区广泛使用，但也对其他本地语言构成挑战。

data.author: gm678
data.article_summary: 这篇文章讨论了在关系型数据库中设计模式时面临的挑战，尤其是处理多态数据（polymorphic data）的困难。多态数据是指可以有多种不同形态的数据类型。文章以患者支付信息为例，说明了如何在SQL中建模这种数据。文章介绍了一种简单的方案——使用具有可空字段的单表模式，即“单表继承”或“层次表”，但这种方法存在一些问题，如难以验证数据的不变性、错误信息不明确以及未来扩展性差。此外，随着数据集的增大，这种设计可能导致性能问题。文章还提到，尽管可以对表添加约束来解决部分问题，但这些约束会变得复杂且难以维护。最终，这种方案需要在数据完整性、可扩展性和性能之间做出权衡。

44505165.article_content:
Blog
Designing a schema for your relational database is a daunting task that has long term implications for the database's performance, maintainability, and correctness. And it often requires making decisions before having a clear picture of the exact shape and distribution of your data, or what the common access patterns will look like. It's not a permanent decision: tables can be altered and databases migrated. But these migrations can be slow and expensive.
To top it all off, some data is less amenable to relational modeling than others.
Polymorphic Data
, in particular, is a common occurrence that is difficult to model in SQL. You've probably worked with polymorphic data before, even if you're not familiar with the term.
Example: Patient Payment Info
Imagine you're a medical provider storing patient payment methods. Every patient is either insured or uninsured, and you need to store different data for each patient based on their insurance status.
If you've written code in a functional language, you might be familiar with algebraic data types. For instance, you could represent this schema in Haskell with the following ADT:
type
Provider
=
String
type
MemberId
=
Int
type
CardNumber
=
String
type
BillingAddress
=
String
data
PaymentInfo
=
Insured
Provider
MemberId
|
Uninsured
CardNumber
BillingAddress
If you're more accustomed to object oriented programming, you might implement this same data type via abstract classes and inheritance, like the following Java code:
abstract
class
PaymentInfo
{
}
class
Insured
extends
PaymentInfo
{
String
provider
;
int
memberId
;
}
class
Uninsured
extends
PaymentInfo
{
String
cardNumber
;
String
billingAddress
;
}
These are both examples of polymorphic data: a datatype where the data can take multiple different shapes. The word comes from Greek roots: "poly" meaning many, and "morph" meaning form. So, data that can take many forms. When a relational database needs to model polymorphic data, we typically use the term
polymorphic association
instead.
Sometimes, like in the above example, a polymorphic association is the best way to model your data type. But there's no obvious way to represent this data in a relational database. If you want to include data like this in your database, you're going to have to make some tradeoffs.
Let's look at some different schemas that attempt to model this data. We're going to use MySQL as our chosen dialect here, but the process is similar regardless of dialect.
Approach 1 - Single Table With Nullable Fields
The simplest schema would be one that has a single table, with a field for each value that
may
appear in a record, or may be
NULL
. Such a schema would look like this:
CREATE
TABLE
patients
(
id
INT
PRIMARY
KEY
,
insurance_provider
TEXT
,
insurance_member_id
INT
,
card_number
TEXT
,
billing_address
TEXT
)
;
In each row, we set
insurance_provider
and
insurance_member_id
if the patient is insured, and
card_number
and
billing_address
if the patient is uninsured. The unused fields get set to
NULL
.
This technique is sometimes also called "Single Table Inheritance" or "Table-Per-Hierarchy", because a single table is used to represent an entire hierarchy of types.
This works, but it has several problems. Mainly, our data has several invariants that the database cannot easily validate. Among them:
In a single row, the fields for insured and uninsured patients should not both be set to non-NULL values.
We would like to enforce that
insurance_member_id
cannot be NULL for insured patients, but we can't add a
NOT NULL
constraint on the column, because it also
must
be
NULL
for uninsured patients.
We can add constraints to the table, but they're pretty obtuse, and the error messages if the constraints get violated are opaque:
CREATE
TABLE
patients
(
id
INT
PRIMARY
KEY
,
insurance_provider
TEXT
,
insurance_member_id
INT
,
card_number
TEXT
,
billing_address
TEXT
,
CHECK
(
(
insurance_provider
IS
NULL
)
=
(
insurance_member_id
IS
NULL
)
)
,
CHECK
(
(
card_number
IS
NULL
)
=
(
billing_address
IS
NULL
)
)
,
CHECK
(
(
insurance_provider
IS
NULL
)
+
(
card_number
IS
NULL
)
=
1
)
)
;
This will result in an error if we attempt to insert a patient record with neither payment type or both payment types, but the error message isn't very helpful:
>
INSERT
INTO
patients
(
id
,
insurance_provider
,
insurance_member_id
)
VALUES
(
1
,
"OneMedical"
,
NULL
)
;
ERROR
3819
(
HY000
)
at line
1
:
Check
constraint
'patients_chk_1'
is
violated
.
These checks would only grow in complexity as the number of fields in each payment method grows. And what if we later want to add a third type of payment info? We'd have to add additional columns to the table, modifying every existing row and changing the table schema.
There's another, more subtle issue happening here: performance. A schema like this is fast for small datasets because storing all the records in a single table allows the engine to perform fewer joins. But as the size of the dataset grows, this table could become a bot

data.title: A Comprehensive Proposal Overviewing Blocks, Nested Functions, and Lambdas for C
data.author: matt_d
data.article_summary: 这篇文章讨论了C语言中如何将数据与函数调用配对的历史演变，重点介绍了`qsort`函数的局限性及后续解决方案。最初，`qsort`只接受一个函数指针，无法传递额外数据，导致开发者需要使用`static`变量或全局变量来实现自定义行为。这带来了数据共享和多线程问题，且被视为不良代码质量的标志。为解决此问题，GNU引入了嵌套函数（Nested Functions），允许函数定义在局部作用域并访问本地数据，避免了全局变量的使用。嵌套函数提供了更直观和安全的解决方案，但其安全性在当时并未被深入理解。文章最后提到嵌套函数的优势包括外观和行为类似常规函数，能访问本地数据，且只需一个函数指针。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：C语言中嵌套函数、可执行栈问题以及C语言的局限性与替代方案

不同观点：
• [uecker的观点]  
  - 认为将GNU嵌套函数加入ISO C标准的提案已经明确指出了可执行栈的问题，并提出了替代实现方式（如引入新的函数类型）。  
  - 不同意将非可执行栈直接视为漏洞的原因，认为这是一种缓解技术，尽管返回导向编程（ROP）可以绕过这种保护，但这种技术仍然很重要。

• [rurban的观点]  
  - 提到C语言中关于函数与数据结合的早期尝试，例如Bruno Haible的回调库（libffcall），这实际上是编译器领域称为闭包的早期实现。

• [pjmlp的观点]  
  - 认为类似功能应通过Objective-C或C++等语言实现，而不是扩展C语言。  
  - 主张接受C语言的局限性，将其视为类似于可移植汇编的语言，承认其安全缺陷，并建议在需要更高抽象和安全性时选择其他语言。

补充讨论：
- 争议的焦点在于C语言是否应该扩展以支持嵌套函数或其他高级特性，还是应该保持其低级特性并依赖其他语言提供更高级的抽象和安全机制。  
- uecker强调了非可执行栈作为缓解技术的重要性，但承认其局限性。  
- rurban提供了有关C语言早期尝试的历史背景，指出了闭包概念的早期实现。  
- pjmlp则主张放弃对C语言的这种扩展，建议使用其他更适合的语言来实现这些功能。

44504933.article_summary: 这篇文章讨论了C语言中如何将数据与函数调用配对的历史演变，重点介绍了`qsort`函数的局限性及后续解决方案。最初，`qsort`只接受一个函数指针，无法传递额外数据，导致开发者需要使用`static`变量或全局变量来实现自定义行为。这带来了数据共享和多线程问题，且被视为不良代码质量的标志。为解决此问题，GNU引入了嵌套函数（Nested Functions），允许函数定义在局部作用域并访问本地数据，避免了全局变量的使用。嵌套函数提供了更直观和安全的解决方案，但其安全性在当时并未被深入理解。文章最后提到嵌套函数的优势包括外观和行为类似常规函数，能访问本地数据，且只需一个函数指针。

主要讨论点：C语言中嵌套函数、可执行栈问题以及C语言的局限性与替代方案

不同观点：
• [uecker的观点]  
  - 认为将GNU嵌套函数加入ISO C标准的提案已经明确指出了可执行栈的问题，并提出了替代实现方式（如引入新的函数类型）。  
  - 不同意将非可执行栈直接视为漏洞的原因，认为这是一种缓解技术，尽管返回导向编程（ROP）可以绕过这种保护，但这种技术仍然很重要。

• [rurban的观点]  
  - 提到C语言中关于函数与数据结合的早期尝试，例如Bruno Haible的回调库（libffcall），这实际上是编译器领域称为闭包的早期实现。

• [pjmlp的观点]  
  - 认为类似功能应通过Objective-C或C++等语言实现，而不是扩展C语言。  
  - 主张接受C语言的局限性，将其视为类似于可移植汇编的语言，承认其安全缺陷，并建议在需要更高抽象和安全性时选择其他语言。

补充讨论：

- uecker强调了非可执行栈作为缓解技术的重要性，但承认其局限性。  
- rurban提供了有关C语言早期尝试的历史背景，指出了闭包概念的早期实现。

data.title: Helm local code execution via a malicious chart
data.author: irke882
data.article_summary: 文章描述了Helm中的一个高危安全漏洞（CVE-2025-53547），影响版本<= 3.18.3。当存在恶意构造的`Chart.yaml`和`Chart.lock`文件时，更新依赖项可能导致本地代码执行。如果`Chart.lock`文件被symlink到可执行文件（如`bash.rc`），更新依赖时会将恶意内容写入该文件，导致 unwanted 执行。该问题已在Helm v3.18.4中修复。临时解决方案是确保`Chart.lock`不是symlink。CVSS评分8.5，表示高严重性，需要用户交互但无需特殊权限。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Helm图表漏洞及其相关技术讨论

不同观点：
• [ivan4th] 认为Helm和文本模板引擎生成YAML的思路本质上是有问题的，特别是需要手动处理空格和换行符等问题，将其与Lisp语言的“括号计数”问题相比较，表达了对Helm使用体验的不满。
• [yelirekim] 详细解释了漏洞的工作原理，描述了攻击者如何通过恶意Chart.yaml文件和符号链接进行攻击，最终导致任意文件写入和代码执行。
• [codebastard] 质疑该漏洞的实际威胁，认为如果攻击者已经有权限访问文件系统并在Helm仓库中放置恶意代码，那么问题可能更加严重，而不仅仅是Helm自身的问题。
• [TheDong] 对漏洞描述中的一些技术细节感到困惑，特别是关于`Chart.lock`文件如何成为符号链接的问题，并提出修复措施应该针对所有可能的符号链接，而非仅限于`Chart.lock`。
• [Sjoerd] 关注攻击场景和安全边界，提出了一系列关于攻击者如何让受害者运行恶意图表的问题，并质疑Helm是否通常以特权用户身份运行。
• [mkagenius] 提到类似工具要求shell访问权限的问题，认为允许LLM通过shell执行生成图表等操作是一个坏主意。
• [agys] 误以为讨论的是与音乐合成器相关的内容，与技术漏洞讨论无关。
• [xyst] 认为该漏洞很有趣，并讨论了个人防护措施，例如使用Nix管理配置文件，以及设置只读分区等方法来预防潜在攻击。
• [sugarpimpdorsey] 对YAML作为配置文件格式提出批评，认为YAML引发多次远程代码执行（RCE）漏洞，反映了其设计上的缺陷。
• [quotemstr] 讽刺地提到内存安全语言也会出现安全漏洞，暗示即使使用这些语言也不能完全避免安全问题。

Package

helm.sh/helm/v3
(
Go
)
Affected versions
<= 3.18.3
Patched versions
3.18.4
Description
A Helm contributor discovered that a specially crafted
Chart.yaml
file along with a specially linked
Chart.lock
file can lead to local code execution when dependencies are updated.
Impact
Fields in a
Chart.yaml
file, that are carried over to a
Chart.lock
file when dependencies are updated and this file is written, can be crafted in a way that can cause execution if that same content were in a file that is executed (e.g., a
bash.rc
file or shell script). If the
Chart.lock
file is symlinked to one of these files updating dependencies will write the lock file content to the symlinked file. This can lead to unwanted execution. Helm warns of the symlinked file but did not stop execution due to symlinking.
This affects when dependencies are updated. When using the
helm
command this happens when
helm dependency update
is run.
helm dependency build
can write a lock file when one does not exist but this vector requires one to already exist. This affects the Helm SDK when the downloader
Manager
performs an update.
Patches
This issue has been resolved in Helm v3.18.4
Workarounds
Ensure the
Chart.lock
file in a chart is not a symlink prior to updating dependencies.
For more information
Helm's security policy is spelled out in detail in our
SECURITY
document.
Credits
Disclosed by Jakub Ciolek at AlphaSense.
Severity
High
8.5

data.title: Where can I see Hokusai's Great Wave today?
data.author: colinprince
data.article_summary:
目前，葛饰北斋的著名作品《神奈川冲浪里》可以在以下地点观看：

- 🇮🇹 特雷维索的Musei Civici，展出至2025年9月28日。
- 🇫🇷 南特的Musée d’histoire，展出至2025年9月7日。

此外，该作品还可在以下地点看到：

- 🇮🇹 的里雅斯特东方艺术博物馆（Civic Museum of Oriental Art, Trieste）
- 🇮🇹 维罗纳的Palazzo Maffei Casa Museo
- 🇺🇸 法明顿的Hill-Stead Museum

另有55个地点也可能会展出该作品。了解更多信息或将博物馆/画廊列入展示列表，可访问相关网站或GitHub页面。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕《神奈川冲浪里》（The Great Wave）的讨论，涉及原作与复制品的区别、作品的展示方式及相关技术问题。

不同观点：
• **原作与复制品的对比**：
   - **[sharkjacobs]** 提出问题：观看原作相比于观看高质量复制品有何优势？尤其当原作本身是印刷品且存在多个版本时。认为原作的历史和文化意义会影响观众的心态，但这是否是唯一原因尚不明确。
   - 复制品的质量可能无法完全捕捉原作的精髓，但原作的展览环境和文化背景确实对观众的体验有很大影响。

• **对《神奈川冲浪里》的艺术价值的讨论**：
   - **[esperent]** 指出，《神奈川冲浪里》虽然是著名作品，但建议观众去了解葛饰北斋的其他作品，如《瀑布修行》，并提到一些不为人知的奇特作品，这些作品能提供对艺术家更全面的理解。
   - 通过对比现代漫画和葛饰北斋的怪异作品，提出艺术市场的供需关系可能自古以来变化不大。

• **关于作品展览的实际操作问题**：
   - **[poulpy123]** 解释了《神奈川冲浪里》可以同时在两个博物馆展出的原因是有大约100个印刷版本，这使得展览更为灵活。
   - **[aosaigh]** 提出关于临时艺术展览如何运作的问题，包括博物馆是否支付费用借展，以及艺术品运输的昂贵和复杂性。

• **个人体验与文化影响**：
   - **[amarchescu]** 分享了个人体验，指出《神奈川冲浪里》原作非常小，与“伟大”的称号形成对比，导致初次见到时几乎错过。
   - **[seafoamteal]** 提到通过阅读小说《Tomorrow and Tomorrow and Tomorrow》了解到这件作品，表明这件艺术品在现代文化中仍有影响力。

• **其他相关评论**：
   - **[NaOH]** 提及之前关于《神奈川冲浪里》的讨论，提供了历史讨论的链接。
   - **[ChrisMarshallNY]** 联想到一个类似的网站，关于名人是否去世的查询，反映了对某些文化现象的持续关注。
   - **[burnt-resistor]** 错误地记得《神奈川冲浪里》出现在某个数学教材封面上，可能是90年代的高中AP微积分教材。
   - **[ChrisArchitect]** 再次提到了2023年关于《神奈川冲浪里》的展示讨论链接。
   - **[darkstar_16]** 开玩笑地建议可以购买乐高版本的《神奈川冲浪里》。

补充讨论：
- 关于《神奈川冲浪里》原作和复制品的讨论揭示了艺术欣赏中的一些复杂因素，如文化背景、作品的历史意义以及复制技术的限制。
- 展览的实际操作问题，如借展和运输，展示了艺术品商业运作的一面。
- 个人体验和文化影响表明，这件作品在不同人群中有不同的意义和价值。
