data.title: Serving a half billion requests per day with Rust and CGI
data.author: feep
data.article_summary:
本文讨论了使用CGI技术处理大量请求的性能测试，特别关注不同编程语言在CGI环境下的表现。作者首先澄清了关于CGI不安全或过时的误解，指出CGI协议本身简单且有效，编写安全的CGI程序与其他HTTP处理代码一样可行。测试在一台60核/240GB内存的虚拟机上进行，使用Vegeta工具和GoHTTP服务器进行负载测试。

测试结果显示，Bash脚本的性能极差，仅达到40请求/秒。Perl表现较好，达到500请求/秒。JavaScript（Node.js）表现超出预期，达到600请求/秒。Python表现最佳，达到700请求/秒。每种语言的CGI程序在测试中均保持100%的成功率。作者强调，基准测试需结合实际环境，测试结果仅供参考。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：CGI（通用网关接口）在现代开发中的使用及其优缺点

不同观点：
• neilv 认为，CGI 在遗留系统和简单系统中仍然有价值。遗留系统可能由高效开发者构建，且运行良好，而简单系统（如家庭路由器上的 Web UI）不需要现代 Web 开发中复杂的工具链。他还提到，现代前端框架（如 Svelte）的复杂性和运行时效率可能不如直接使用 CGI/SCGI。
• pkal 分享了自己用 Go 编写 CGI 脚本的经验，认为在访问量很小的情况下，效率不是问题，重要的是使用标准库中的工具（如 HTML 模板）来编写安全代码。他提供了自己的 CGI 示例并邀请他人测试。
• kragen 引用了之前关于 CGI 性能的讨论，提供了不同语言实现 CGI 的性能数据，指出 Rust 和 C 的性能最好，而 Go 的性能相对较低。他还质疑了所使用的 web 服务器是否是性能瓶颈。
• simonw 对 CGI 示例代码表示赞赏，认为这些代码展示了如何用多种语言实现 SQLite 支持的留言板。
• antoineleclair 分享了在 Disco 项目中使用 CGI 支持扩展的经验，认为 CGI 的简单性和灵活性使其适用于让开发者使用任意语言，但不推荐用于大型生产站点。
• 0xbadcafebee 认为，Bash 脚本在嵌入式设备上非常适合用作 CGI，因其体积小且可以调用其他程序处理复杂任务，但需要注意安全性（如使用基本认证）。
• shrubble 提到在企业环境中常见过度配置的 VM 用于低请求量的内部站点，并指出复杂应用服务器和 web 服务器的集成可能导致不必要的开销。
• jchw 不理解为何有人希望回归 CGI，认为尽管 CGI 能达到很高的请求处理量，但现代的 FastCGI 和其他模型更为优越，特别是在安全性和性能方面。他还指出，在现代环境中设置单独的应用服务器比使用 CGI 更合适。
• hedgehog 认为，CGI 在处理低频请求的多个应用时仍然有意义，因为无需在服务器上保留常驻内存的应用进程，且静态文件可以通过 web 服务器直接提供。
• carodgers 提到 Python 3 已移除 CGI 支持，并询问现代的替代方案。
• rokob 对 Rust 和 C 在尾部延迟方面的表现相似表示好奇。
• dengolius 建议使用更快的 Go 第三方库（如 fasthttp）替代 gohttpd。
• exabrial 抱怨现代 JavaScript 前端在低带宽环境下的表现不佳，并表示欢迎 FastCGI 和服务器端渲染，认为大部分任务不需要复杂的 JavaScript。
• oxcabe 建议将 CGI 与 WASI 和 WebAssembly 进行性能对比，以探索新的设计方式。

补充讨论：
• CGI 的安全性和性能是讨论的焦点，特别是与 FastCGI 和其他现代技术的比较。
• 不同语言在 CGI 实现中的性能表现引起了关注，特别是 Rust 和 C 的高性能表现。
• 对现代开发中过度复杂的工具链和前端框架的批评，以及对简单解决方案的回归呼吁。
• 实际应用场景中，CGI 仍然在遗留系统和简单系统中具有实用价值，但在大型生产环境中的适用性受到质疑。

44493174.article_content:
In my previous post
Serving 200 million requests per day with a cgi-bin
, I did some quick performance testing of CGI using a program written in Go.
Go works excellently for CGI programs, for many of the same reasons it works so well for CLI programs and system daemons.
But, out of curiosity, I decided to do a bit more CGI testing with other languages.
CGI is good technology, actually
#
There’s a misconception that because CGI is old or because many CGI scripts had security vulnerabilities, CGI itself is somehow insecure or bad.
That’s just not the case. CGI is a simple protocol that works very well.
It’s not any more or less difficult to write secure CGI programs than it is to write any other kind of HTTP handler code.
The common alternatives to CGI, FastCGI and reverse proxies, aren’t a free lunch and have their own security complications.
The benchmarking server
#
This time I used an AMD Genoa-based 60 vCPU / 240 GB RAM virtual machine to serve as a reasonable medium-sized machine.
Running benchmarks in VMs isn’t ideal because of noisy neighbor problems and other sources of variable performance.
However, when doing macrobenchmarking, it’s less of a concern and the results are fairly consistent. This is even more true when using a larger VM, where there are fewer neighbors on the host.
Still, I do always prefer bare metal, but sometimes you leave your servers behind for other people to enjoy.
I miss “my” beautiful servers but they’re in good hands and at least I can still post to them and visualize the disk and network IO and CPU usage, which isn’t creepy to do, it’s actually perfectly normal.
I do not miss Nandos in DC and their unrefrigerated sauces!
[image or embed]
— Jake Gold (
@jacob.gold
)
November 12, 2024 at 8:11 PM
Standard benchmarking disclaimer
#
Benchmarking of any kind is fraught, and it’s easy to make mistakes, which is why there’s no substitute for real-world testing in your own environment.
The CGI programs written in each language are broadly similar but their implementations do vary. Some use well-tested libraries while others do manual parsing and are minor abominations.
The HTTP load testing tool
vegeta
was used this time for improved accuracy.
Only
gohttpd
webserver was used this time because getting Apache to stop being the bottleneck proved somewhat difficult.
The updated code and Dockerfiles are on GitHub
https://github.com/Jacob2161/cgi-bin
Benchmarking Bash
guestbook-sh.cgi
#
No one should ever run a Bash script under CGI. It’s almost impossible to do so securely, and performance is terrible.
But it’s kind of funny to see that it does actually work.
Bash reached just 40 requests per second before saturating all available CPUs.

44493174.article_summary:
本文讨论了使用CGI技术处理大量请求的性能测试，特别关注不同编程语言在CGI环境下的表现。作者首先澄清了关于CGI不安全或过时的误解，指出CGI协议本身简单且有效，编写安全的CGI程序与其他HTTP处理代码一样可行。测试在一台60核/240GB内存的虚拟机上进行，使用Vegeta工具和GoHTTP服务器进行负载测试。

测试结果显示，Bash脚本的性能极差，仅达到40请求/秒。Perl表现较好，达到500请求/秒。JavaScript（Node.js）表现超出预期，达到600请求/秒。Python表现最佳，达到700请求/秒。每种语言的CGI程序在测试中均保持100%的成功率。作者强调，基准测试需结合实际环境，测试结果仅供参考。
44493174.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：CGI（通用网关接口）在现代开发中的使用及其优缺点

不同观点：
• neilv 认为，CGI 在遗留系统和简单系统中仍然有价值。遗留系统可能由高效开发者构建，且运行良好，而简单系统（如家庭路由器上的 Web UI）不需要现代 Web 开发中复杂的工具链。他还提到，现代前端框架（如 Svelte）的复杂性和运行时效率可能不如直接使用 CGI/SCGI。
• pkal 分享了自己用 Go 编写 CGI 脚本的经验，认为在访问量很小的情况下，效率不是问题，重要的是使用标准库中的工具（如 HTML 模板）来编写安全代码。他提供了自己的 CGI 示例并邀请他人测试。
• kragen 引用了之前关于 CGI 性能的讨论，提供了不同语言实现 CGI 的性能数据，指出 Rust 和 C 的性能最好，而 Go 的性能相对较低。他还质疑了所使用的 web 服务器是否是性能瓶颈。
• simonw 对 CGI 示例代码表示赞赏，认为这些代码展示了如何用多种语言实现 SQLite 支持的留言板。
• antoineleclair 分享了在 Disco 项目中使用 CGI 支持扩展的经验，认为 CGI 的简单性和灵活性使其适用于让开发者使用任意语言，但不推荐用于大型生产站点。
• 0xbadcafebee 认为，Bash 脚本在嵌入式设备上非常适合用作 CGI，因其体积小且可以调用其他程序处理复杂任务，但需要注意安全性（如使用基本认证）。
• shrubble 提到在企业环境中常见过度配置的 VM 用于低请求量的内部站点，并指出复杂应用服务器和 web 服务器的集成可能导致不必要的开销。
• jchw 不理解为何有人希望回归 CGI，认为尽管 CGI 能达到很高的请求处理量，但现代的 FastCGI 和其他模型更为优越，特别是在安全性和性能方面。他还指出，在现代环境中设置单独的应用服务器比使用 CGI 更合适。
• hedgehog 认为，CGI 在处理低频请求的多个应用时仍然有意义，因为无需在服务器上保留常驻内存的应用进程，且静态文件可以通过 web 服务器直接提供。
• carodgers 提到 Python 3 已移除 CGI 支持，并询问现代的替代方案。
• rokob 对 Rust 和 C 在尾部延迟方面的表现相似表示好奇。
• dengolius 建议使用更快的 Go 第三方库（如 fasthttp）替代 gohttpd。
• exabrial 抱怨现代 JavaScript 前端在低带宽环境下的表现不佳，并表示欢迎 FastCGI 和服务器端渲染，认为大部分任务不需要复杂的 JavaScript。
• oxcabe 建议将 CGI 与 WASI 和 WebAssembly 进行性能对比，以探索新的设计方式。

补充讨论：
• CGI 的安全性和性能是讨论的焦点，特别是与 FastCGI 和其他现代技术的比较。
• 不同语言在 CGI 实现中的性能表现引起了关注，特别是 Rust 和 C 的高性能表现。
• 对现代开发中过度复杂的工具链和前端框架的批评，以及对简单解决方案的回归呼吁。
• 实际应用场景中，CGI 仍然在遗留系统和简单系统中具有实用价值，但在大型生产环境中的适用性受到质疑。

data.article_summary: 这篇文章介绍了zvdb-z80项目的基本信息。zvdb-z80是一个开源项目，用户可以对其进行复制（Fork）和标记星标（Star）。目前，该项目有1次复制和19个星标。文章还提到，要更改通知设置，用户必须登录。文章内容简短，主要涉及项目的基本互动和状态。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕技术优化、代码质量、写作风格以及对文章标题的看法展开的讨论。

不同观点：
• _notreallyme_: 认为在无MMU处理器和现代MMU甚至NUMA能力处理器上的代码优化有很大不同。作者在频率快857倍的处理器上仅获得3到6倍的加速，表明旧的优化技巧在现代架构上已经过时。虽然执行管道优化仍然有效，但不考虑缓存层次、内存管理方式以及RAM访问时机，会导致次优代码。

• martinald: 分享个人学习经历，提到在90年代末学习技术时，由于互联网和网络相对较新，需要掌握很多基础知识来解决问题。由于经济限制，必须充分利用手中资源，这也促使他学到很多技术知识。

• U1F984: 质疑文章中“查找表总是比计算快”的观点，认为由于现代内存速度比CPU慢，查找表的优势仅在数据能 fit 进L1缓存的情况下才成立。现代CPU在主内存访问时间内可以完成大量计算。

• orbifold: 认为文章的写作风格和段落长度表明这篇文章完全是由AI生成的。

• reidrac: 对文章中的Z80代码示例提出质疑，指出代码中存在不必要的操作和错误选择，如未使用的IX寄存器和不合理的循环计数方式。

补充讨论：
• faefox: 认为文章的AI生成风格分散了读者的注意力，影响了对技术内容的关注。

• bravesoul2: 调侃文章的写作风格类似于LinkedIn上关于B2B销售的经验分享文章。

• IceDane: 对文章中“移植SAP”的表述提出质疑，认为作者只是移植了自己为SAP平台编写的程序，而非整个SAP系统，将移植SAP比作移植人类所有已知癌症，强调其规模和难度。

• mdaniel: 提醒作者在代码仓库中添加许可证，猜测作者可能偏好MIT许可证，并建议明确声明。

• renewiltord: 认为文章标题有 clickbait 的嫌疑，虽然内容有趣，但标题更像是为了吸引点击。

• peteforde: 对作者是否了解如何像Z80一样编写ABAP代码提出疑问，希望文章能对此进行解释。

争议焦点：
• 文章的技术内容和代码示例的准确性受到质疑，特别是Z80代码示例和“查找表总是比计算快”的观点。
• 文章的写作风格和标题是否具有误导性或clickbait性质引发讨论。

data.title: Systemd has been a complete, utter, unmitigated success
data.author: Mond_
data.article_summary: 本文回顾了systemd从2013年引发争议到2025年被广泛认可的成功历程。作者承认曾对systemd用二进制日志替换纯文本日志及其对init系统的改变感到不满，但经过多年使用，作者改变看法，认为systemd是传统init系统的成功继任者。文章指出，旧的init系统存在脚本质量不一、依赖管理混乱等问题，而systemd通过支持多种进程管理模式、提供简单配置格式、以及向后兼容等特性，有效解决了这些问题。此外，systemd带来的新功能如journald日志系统，虽然起初因二进制格式受到批评，但实际上提供了更高效的日志管理和压缩功能。作者赞扬了systemd在兼容性和易用性方面的努力，认为其成功并非偶然。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：对Linux系统中systemd的评价和争议

不同观点：
• 支持systemd的观点：
  - haiku2077：作为有多年经验的系统管理员，他认为systemd解决了许多Linux管理中的痛点，受到了同事和合作者的欢迎。
  - artooro：喜欢systemd，因为创建服务更简单，只需写一个简单的配置文件，而不需要复杂的init脚本。
  - spicyusername：从RHEL 6升级到7时，体验到systemd让许多日常系统管理任务变得更简单。
  - pram：喜欢systemd的init/service/unit-file部分，认为它具有强大的安全和cron功能，同时也喜欢journald。
  - dontlaugh：认为systemd比launchd和upstart更好。

• 反对systemd的观点：
  - pessimizer：认为systemd的成功只是因为它比init脚本更容易使用，但其背后是Redhat对Linux的控制，这导致Linux变得更像是一个IBM产品，存在依赖性和垄断问题。
  - rootnod3：不认为systemd是成功的，指出它迫使其他软件（如GDM、Podman、Pipewire）产生锁定效应。

• 中立或混合观点：
  - bcoates：对journald持怀疑态度，两年前尝试时发现它不兼容云监控软件，需要使用第三方工具或重新配置。
  - shrubble：务实观点，如果其他人管理服务器，他们可以使用systemd；但如果自己负责，会选择非systemd发行版或FreeBSD。
  - iambvk：不是系统管理员，每三个月才用一次systemd命令，觉得systemd的变化对自己是个麻烦。

补充讨论：
- up2isomorphism：指出还有许多发行版没有使用systemd，因此称其为“完全、彻底的成功”似乎有些夸张。
- tylerjl：作为文章作者，承认标题有些夸张以吸引注意，但感谢大家的讨论和反馈。

争议焦点：
- systemd是否导致了Linux的垄断和依赖性问题（pessimizer的观点），以及它是否真的比其他替代方案更优越（反对与支持观点的交锋）。

44507411.article_content:
«
systemd has been a complete, utter, unmitigated success
8 July, 2025
1,782 words
7 minute read time
Figure 1:
The systemd wars of the tenties were harsh and casualties were many
The year is 2013 and I am
hopping mad
.
systemd
is replacing my plaintext logs with a binary format and pumping steroids into
init
and it is
laughing
at me.
The unix philosophy cries out: is this the end of Linux (or, as many are calling it, GNU plus Linux)?
The year is 2025 and I’m here to repent.
Not only is
systemd
a worthy successor to traditional
init
, but I think that it deserves a defense for what it’s done for the landscape – especially given the hostile reception it initially received (and somehow continues to receive? for some reason?).
No software is perfect – except for
TempleOS
– but I think that systemd has largely been a success story and proven many dire forecasts wrong (including my own).
I was wrong!
The
init
Paleolithic
I hope that I don't need to whine about why the old status quo wasn't great – init scripts of varying quality with janky dependencies and wildly varying semantics were frustrating.
It's sort of wild to me that I was working as a full-time software engineer during an era in which we were still writing bespoke
shell
scripts to orchestrate process management.
"Lost" or unmanaged processes, the weirdness of
S99
-type directories for dependency ordering, and different interfaces into
/etc/init.d
scripts were all real problems.
Figure 2:
/etc/init.d, uh, finds a way
During the
LINUX INIT WARS
, you could probably write an upstart, s6, or OpenRC init script that didn't have
too
many problems.
But
even then
you're supporting a variety of service management configuration formats with slightly differing behaviors.
I wrote services for all of these different init systems!
And the experience wasn't super!
Many of the deficiencies of traditional service management are more obvious in hindsight.
Whereas bare-bones
init
was mostly about handling and/or reaping orphaned processes, entrusting a systemd-based PID 1 is also big for sandboxing and dependency management.
We haven't even talked about timers, sockets, or mounts, either.
I Deprecated Your Mom
We don't need to re-tread in great detail the history of
how
we arrived here.
But the
how
is part of the reason I think systemd worked out in the end.
Consider that the two primary ways that older init systems managed processes – either foregrounded or forked – were (and are!) fully supported modes.
Modern systemd provides for more nuanced "I'm ready" signaling apart from "is the process alive" (via
Type
=
notify
), but this kind of backward compatability really helped bridge the legacy gap.
The systemd authors even wrote
generator code to help migrate old services
.
I don't think the ini-style configuration format is a panacea (I like
Dhall
), but that's another olive branch from systemd authors to system administrators: it doesn't require a turing-complete configuration format or domain-specific language.
You can generally understand what this means when you read it and how to change it:
Systemd
Font used to highlight builtins.
Font used to highlight keywords.
Font used to highlight type and class names.
[Service]
Type
=
forking
Defaults matter
and configuration languages matter, too.
I appreciate that systemd chose one that is obvious.
I can cite other examples but the point I want to make is that systemd deliberately chose
backward compatability,
simple configuration paradigms,
and to proactively support and help folks migrate.
Not every open source project chooses to take explicit steps to support old paths on the road to deprecation.
Lennart, you sweetheart.
Trust the Process
I don't just think that systemd is our newer, cooler Dad now that does previously-annoying things better, but that systemd also brought us good,
brand new
things.
Won't Somebody Think of the Plaintext?
Figure 3:
Logged logs logging loggily
journald
is here.
Past Me hated it, too.
The primary complaint with journald is that its journal files aren't in plaintext.
Do I miss that? A little, yeah. I'm sort of a Linux boomer at heart and like to use
awk
for everything.
However, I
really
like having one place to send
stdout
and
stderr
!
Have you ever leveraged custom fields when writing logs to the journal natively?
I attach
NOTIFY_SLACK=1
to some of my services and listen to my lab's log stream for these events and forward them along to a Slack channel to see logs I want more easily, it's great!
Moreover, delegating the responsibility to journald is also convenient from a rotation and disk space perspective.
With an awareness of filesystem space, I essentially never have to make rough guesses about rotation frequency any more, either
1
.
Are you aware that part of the reason your journal files are in a binary format rather than plaintext because journald is compressing them transparently?
That default choice is probably saving exabytes of space in aggregate across the entire computing space.
44507411.article_summary: 本文回顾了systemd从2013年引发争议到2025年被广泛认可的成功历程。作者承认曾对systemd用二进制日志替换纯文本日志及其对init系统的改变感到不满，但经过多年使用，作者改变看法，认为systemd是传统init系统的成功继任者。文章指出，旧的init系统存在脚本质量不一、依赖管理混乱等问题，而systemd通过支持多种进程管理模式、提供简单配置格式、以及向后兼容等特性，有效解决了这些问题。此外，systemd带来的新功能如journald日志系统，虽然起初因二进制格式受到批评，但实际上提供了更高效的日志管理和压缩功能。作者赞扬了systemd在兼容性和易用性方面的努力，认为其成功并非偶然。

data.title: Nvidia Becomes First Company to Reach $4T Market Cap
data.author: mfiguiere
data.article_summary: Nvidia股票在周三上涨超过2%，市值首次突破4万亿美元，成为历史上首家达到这一里程碑的公司，主要受益于生成式AI需求的激增。尽管面临地缘政治紧张局势和针对中国市场的芯片销售限制，Nvidia仍凭借其在AI硬件和芯片领域的领导地位，实现了显著增长。自2022年底ChatGPT推出以来，Nvidia的图形处理单元需求激增，推动其股价在过去五年中上涨超过15倍。尽管对中国市场的出口限制导致约80亿美元的销售损失，Nvidia仍超越微软和苹果，成为全球市值最高的公司。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Nvidia的高市值是否合理以及其未来发展潜力

不同观点：
• **对Nvidia高市值的疑惑**：
  - [nkzd] 认为Nvidia作为一个不生产自己芯片的“脆弱”公司，成为全球市值最高的公司难以理解。他质疑为何不是一些更为“基础”的行业如石油或航运公司占据这个位置。
  
• **对Nvidia高市值的担忧与潜在风险**：
  - [ra7] 认为Nvidia目前4万亿美元的市值高得令人难以置信，联想到互联网时代的思科（Cisco）泡沫。他提出可能导致Nvidia衰落的两个因素：(a) AI领域失望和公司无法通过GPU变现 (b) 大公司自研芯片降低对Nvidia GPU的需求。他还建议Nvidia通过提供定制芯片设计服务来应对(b)。

• **长期成功的文化和创始人影响**：
  - [chubot] 认为长期努力和同一文化背景的成功是关键，Nvidia的两次成功（图形处理和可编程GPU）相隔约20年。他比较了苹果和谷歌的成功模式，并指出当创始人离开后，公司内部的效率和创造力可能会下降。

• **Nvidia早期艰难历史**：
  - [LarsDu88] 提到Nvidia在90年代多次接近破产，特别是与Sega的Dreamcast合同失败后，公司几乎毁灭。

  - [nativeit] 通过简化的计算指出，Nvidia需要卖出数十亿单位GPU才能达到4万亿美元的收入，而目前仅卖出几百万单位。他认为投资者可能在缺乏实质性技术进步的情况下，强行制造增长的假象。

  - [pinkmuffinere] 指出市值比较需要考虑通胀调整，并编辑补充认为Nvidia可能是历史上最高估值的公司。

  - [bentt] 认为Nvidia高市值主要反映了美元贬值。

  - [amelius] 建议Nvidia应该开始建立自己的芯片制造厂。

补充讨论：
• **对未来公司市值的幽默预测**：
  - [TriangleEdge] 幽默地问道，是否能在有生之年看到第一个万亿美元公司或一个100美元的香蕉。

Key Points
Nvidia stock jumped Wednesday and pushed the company past a $4 trillion market cap for the first time ever.
The chipmaker is the first company to achieve this milestone and has benefited from the generative AI boom.
The recent rally in Nvidia has come despite geopolitical tensions and ongoing chip curbs that have hampered sales to China.

Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang attends a roundtable discussion at the Viva Technology conference dedicated to innovation and startups at Porte de Versailles exhibition center in Paris on June 11, 2025.
Sarah Meyssonnier | Reuters
Nvidia
stock jumped more than 2% on Wednesday, lifting the company's market cap past $4 trillion for the first time as investors scooped up shares of the tech giant building the bulk of the hardware for the generative
artificial intelligence
boom.
The chipmaker is the first company to ever achieve this market value.
Nvidia is the world's most valuable company, surpassing
Microsoft
and
Apple
, both of which hit the $3 trillion mark before Nvidia. Microsoft is also one of Nvidia's biggest and most important customers.
The California-based company, which was founded in 1993, first passed the $2 trillion mark in February 2024, and surpassed $3 trillion in June.
Nvidia has profited heavily from the growing demand for AI hardware and chips since the launch of ChatGPT in late 2022. The company has positioned itself as the decisive leader in creating the graphics processing units that power large language models.
Read more CNBC tech news

Elon Musk lashes out at Tesla bull Dan Ives over board proposals: 'Shut up'
The surge in demand has boosted shares in the chipmaking behemoth more than fifteenfold over the last five years. Shares are up more than 15% over the last month and 22% since the start of the year.
The recent rally in Nvidia has come despite geopolitical tensions and ongoing chip curbs that have hampered sales to China. Last month, Nvidia said that a recent export restriction on its H20 chips created for China would
cost it $8 billion
in lost sales.
"The $50 billion China market is effectively closed to U.S. industry," Huang said during a May earnings call.
Huang previously
told CNBC
that getting blocked from selling chips in China would be a "tremendous loss" for the company.

data.title: Privacy campaigners pour cold water on London cops 1k facial recognition arrests
data.author: rntn
data.article_summary: 隐私权活动人士对伦敦警方使用实时面部识别技术（LFR）逮捕1000人的成效表示质疑，认为这是对纳税人资金的低效使用和对公民自由的侵犯。尽管警方声称该技术提高了办案效率，但活动组织“老大哥观察”（BBW）指出，自2020年以来，LFR逮捕人数仅占总逮捕数的0.15%，且耗费了大量警力资源。BBW认为，LFR技术不仅成本高昂，还缺乏法律监管，可能导致错误识别并侵犯公民权利。尽管警方强调LFR帮助侦破严重犯罪案件，如性侵和跟踪，但批评者担心该技术在英国正变得愈发普遍，且缺乏足够的法律监督。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：技术对社会的影响及政府响应能力

不同观点：
• Kennywinker认为该技术对社会有害，不应该在任何地方部署。他们的主要论据是政府对民众的需求不够 responsive（回应性），而在这种情况下自动化执法只会进一步削弱政府对民众需求的回应能力。
• 隐含观点：可能存在另一部分人（虽然未直接引用）认为该技术有其经济或效率上的好处（例如kennywinker提到"roi was awesome"），即投资回报很好，暗示该技术在某些方面是有价值的。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点在于技术的潜在社会危害与经济效益之间的权衡。Kennywinker显然更关注技术对社会和政治体系的长远影响，而非短期的经济利益。
• 另一个值得注意的讨论点是政府是否具备足够的回应能力以及技术进步是否会削弱这一能力，这也是kennywinker的观点核心。
• 技术在执法自动化中的角色和影响是另一个值得进一步探讨的议题，尤其是自动化是否会导致执法过程中的进一步去人性化和不透明性。

44509275.article_content:
Security
23
Privacy campaigners pour cold water on London cops' 1,000 facial recognition arrests
23
Activists argue the resources spent on tech aren't leading to worthwhile numbers
Connor Jones
Wed 9 Jul 2025
//
08:30 UTC
Privacy activists are unimpressed with London's Metropolitan Police and its use of live facial recognition (LFR) to catch criminals, saying it is not effective use of taxpayer money and an overreach by government.
The Met released data on Friday that it hoped would imbue a sense of confidence in the controversial privacy busting technology, with the force's LFR chief saying it improves efficiency.
Never ones to pass up an opportunity to bash LFR, campaign group Big Brother Watch (BBW) argued the numbers don't truly reflect the message that police are better off with what it calls "Orwellian tech."
According to the
raw data
published by the Met, London's police made 715,296 arrests in total since 2020. 1,035 of these were made with the support of LFR, and 773 led to charges or police cautions.
BBW said this represents just a small percentage of the total, arguing that the return on investment in the technology, trials for which began in 2016, hasn't been as fruitful as intended.
"Arrests made with the technology represent just 0.15 percent of all arrests made in the capital during that time, despite significant police resources being plowed into its expansion," the campaign group said.
"Policing resources are threadbare in London, and with many serious crimes not even being investigated, spending millions of pounds on rights-abusing technology is an insult to Londoners. The expansion of facial recognition technology comes at a serious cost to the taxpayer, to our civil liberties, and to stretched policing resources."
For context, BBW's calculations were based on data going back to 2020, and London's police only released LFR arrest figures from the start of 2024.
Since then, LFR arrests account for 0.57 percent of the total 180,947. So, not a great deal better but considerably more compared to the way BBW framed it.
Met LFR chief Lindsey Chiswick last week lauded the initiative's results.
"Live facial recognition is a powerful tool, which is helping us deliver justice for victims, including those who have been subjected to horrendous offences, such as rape and serious assault," she said.
"It is not only saving our officers' valuable time but delivering faster, more accurate results to catch criminals – helping us be more efficient than ever before."
The Met added that LFR interventions don't always lead to arrests. Sometimes they help inform officers of offenders' conditions being breached, such as registered sex offenders and convicted stalkers, describing them as "crucial."
One such example is the case of David Cheneler, 73, a registered sex offender caught by LFR cameras in a police van parked in Denmark Hill.
With Cheneler's face added to the LFR database, cameras spotted him and officers investigated since he had a Sexual Harm Prevention Order (SHPO), which prohibited him from being alone with a child under the age of 14.
Cheneler was picked up by Met Police officers and found to be in the company of a six-year-old girl, as well as an offensive weapon.
His arrest and resultant guilty plea landed him two years in prison. He was sentenced on May 20.
UK facial recognition grows ever-pervasive
Facial recognition technology is often associated with authoritarian states, particularly China, which uses it for mass surveillance of its citizens, and that's the common example privacy campaigners like to use when arguing against its use in the UK and other democracies.
However, deployment shows no signs of slowing down, and based on recent events it appears to be at the heart of the UK's policing strategy.
Prime Minister Keir Starmer, a former human rights lawyer,
said LFR would be at the center of the UK's response to riots
that broke out across England last year, months after the Lords' Justice and Home Affairs Committee told his predecessor that it
lacked a legal basis
.
UK's first permanent facial recognition cameras installed in South London
Smile! UK cops spend tens of millions on live facial recognition tech
NFL to begin using face scanning tech across all of its stadiums
Keir Starmer says facial recognition tech is the answer to far-right riots
Indeed, there are no laws that oversee the police's use of facial recognition in the UK, and for such an intrusive technology
with a controversial history
, many deem the lack of oversight a significant concern.
"Facial recognition technology remains dangerously unregulated in the UK, meaning police forces are writing their own rules about how they use the technology and who they place on watchlists," said BBW.
"This is an authoritarian technology that can have life-changing consequences when it makes mistakes, yet neither the public nor parliament has ever voted on it."
The Met is not oblivious to criticism of LFR. Offering some comfort to the wary

data.title: That white guy who can't get a job at Tim Hortons? He's AI
data.author: pseudolus
data.article_summary: CBC新闻调查发现，TikTok上一名抱怨在加拿大难找工作的白人男子“Josh”其实是人工智能生成的虚假人物。这些视频由AI公司Nexa制作，旨在通过假冒影响（fake-fluencing）推广其招聘软件。视频中，“Josh”发表了关于移民抢走工作的种族性言论，例如称印度人抢走了Tim Hortons的工作。TikTok已因违反社区指南下架这些视频。营销专家指出，这种欺骗性营销手法极不道德，具有高度误导性。Nexa公司称制作这些视频是为了与有类似观点的年轻人产生共鸣，但此举引发了广泛批评。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：TikTok及其内容（特别是涉及误导性视频和种族问题）的影响和后果

不同观点：
• [glonq] 认为TikTok的使命之一是在西方自由国家传播分歧和不和，尤其是利用人们普遍缺乏批判性思维的弱点。因此，TikTok应该被彻底禁止。

• [streptomycin] 则指出，这些有争议的内容实际上是一个印度人为了推广他的AI公司而制造的营销噱头，暗示整个事件是一个人为操作的骗局，而非TikTok本身的策略。

• [morkalork] 关注社会经济问题，认为多伦多高 youth 失业率（约20%）是引发对移民不满情绪的根本原因，并将这种不满情绪与类似视频内容的传播联系起来，暗示社会经济问题比视频本身更值得关注。

• [joemazerino] 对CBC（加拿大广播公司）在面对AI生成内容的处理上提出质疑，认为CBC以内容由AI生成作为借口来回避对自身传播误导性信息的批评，指出CBC本身也有传播错误信息的记录。

• [dogleash] 讨论了这些有争议视频的营销策略，认为虽然这些视频内容不符合常规道德标准，但它们的传播效果不容忽视。他进一步推测，这些视频的制作者和营销团队误判了观众的接受度，但仍然成功引起了广泛讨论。此外，他指出Tim Hortons（Tim's）由于声誉受损而不得不通过CBC发布声明来澄清自己不涉及种族主义问题，而非真正关心种族主义本身。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点在于TikTok和其他社交媒体平台上的误导性内容是否应该通过禁止平台或加强监管来解决，以及这些内容背后的动机（商业营销、社会经济问题等）是什么。
• 不同评论者对事件的背后推手有不同看法，有人认为是平台问题，有人认为是个人或企业的营销策略，还有人认为根本原因是社会经济问题。
• 评论还涉及CBC等媒体机构在处理此类争议时的角色及其自身的信誉问题。

News
That white guy who can't get a job at Tim Hortons? He's AI
A series of AI-generated videos that show a white man complaining about how difficult it is to get a job in Canada have been taken down by TikTok, following inquiries made by the CBC News Visual Investigations team.
TikTok removes racially charged videos, made with latest version of Google's Veo
David Michael Lamb
,
Ashley Fraser
,
Andrew Kitchen
·
CBC News
·
Posted: Jul 09, 2025 4:00 AM EDT | Last Updated: 7 hours ago
That white guy who can’t get a job at Tim Hortons? He’s AI
7 hours ago
Duration
3:26
‘Josh’ was an AI avatar covertly marketing on TikTok for a company that works with recruiting firms. Some of the videos were racially charged. CBC’s Visual Investigations team tracked down his creators to get some answers.
Social Sharing
A series of AI-generated videos that show a white man complaining about how difficult it is to get a job in Canada have been taken down by TikTok, following inquiries made by the CBC News Visual Investigations team.
The social media platform says the videos violated its
community guidelines
, because it wasn't clear enough that they were made with AI.
Most of the videos feature what looks like a white man in his 20s named "Josh," who speaks to the camera and makes racially charged statements about immigrants and their role in the job market. In fact, "Josh" is created by AI and doesn't exist.
In one video, he complains he can't get a job because people from India have taken them all, particularly at Tim Hortons. He claims that he applied for a job at the doughnut shop and was asked if he spoke Punjabi.
In a statement, Tim Hortons said the emergence of videos such as this have been extremely frustrating and concerning for the company, and adds that it has had difficulty getting them taken down.
A TikTok account that featured AI-generated videos of a white man complaining he couldn't get a job in Canada, has since been taken down. It's part of a trend known as 'fake-fluencing.'
(Unemployedflex/TikTok)
In another video, "Josh" attacks Canada's immigration policy, asking why so many people are admitted to Canada when there aren't enough jobs to go around.
It's part of a trend known as "fake-fluencing." That's when companies create fake personas with AI in order to make it look like a real person is endorsing a product or service. The company in this case is Nexa, an AI firm that develops software that other companies can use to recruit new hires. Some of the videos feature Nexa logos in the scene. The company's founder and CEO Divy Nayyar calls that a "subconscious placement" of advertising.
The man in the videos complains he can't get a job because Indian immigrants have taken them all. There are subtle clues he isn't real. His hand holds a coffee cup unconvincingly, and is a different colour from his other hand. There is also a small logo for Google's Veo AI software in the corner.
(Unemployedflex/TikTok)
In an interview with CBC News, he said he wanted to "have fun" with the idea held by some that "Indians are taking over the job market." He says he created the "Josh" persona as a way of connecting with those who have similar views: young people just out of school who are looking for work.
Marketing experts say it's deceptive and unethical.
"This type of content and highly polarizing storytelling is something that we would expect from far-right groups," said York University marketing professor Markus Giesler.
"For a company to use this kind of campaign tonality in order to attract consumers to its services is highly, highly problematic and highly, highly unethical and unlike anything that I've ever seen."
Far more convincing
Making videos such as this has never been easier. Nayyar says his company made them with Google's Veo AI software and some other tools. The latest iteration, Veo3, was released in May, and can make videos from text prompts that are far more convincing than previous versions.
Obvious clues such as people with extra fingers or physical impossibilities appear less frequently in Veo3. The audio is often indistinguishable from real human voices, and matches the lip movements of the characters in the scene, something previous AI video generators struggled with.
A screenshot of a comment about one of the videos. Some TikTok users spotted the fakery, while others complained about the racist messaging.
(Unemployedflex/TikTok)
But some TikTok users were not fooled. They called the videos out as AI-generated in the comments. But others responded to what they referred to as the racist message, suggesting they believed they were watching a real person. In some cases, "Josh," the fake character, responds to them in the comments to defend himself, further implying he is real.
Marvin Ryder, an associate professor of marketing at McMaster University in Hamilton, says he was initially taken in. "I was convinced that this was a real character and had a real story that he was trying to tell in his little eight-se

data.title: Solar power has begun to transform the world’s energy system
data.author: dmazin
data.article_summary: 自20世纪70年代以来，可再生能源故事不断被讲述，但直到最近两年，可再生能源才真正成为全球主流且具成本效益的选择。自1954年发明光伏电池以来，全球安装太阳能的第一个太瓦用时近70年，而第二个太瓦仅用两年，第三个太瓦预计将在今年或明年达成。2022年，96%的新增电力需求由可再生能源满足，美国93%的新增发电能力来自太阳能、风能和储能设备。加州在可再生能源使用上创下纪录，而德州在可再生能源和储能安装方面甚至超过了加州。中国则是全球可再生能源安装和出口的领头羊，其碳排放已开始下降。这一转变为应对气候危机带来了巨大希望。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：对太阳能技术及其未来发展的不同观点和讨论

不同观点：
• **太阳能技术的积极面**：
  ◦ [danaris] 认为太阳能的增长令人惊叹，超出过去的预测，并指出太阳能对农民的直接好处，如减少燃料成本。
  ◦ [thomascountz] 强调太阳能经济性的成功，指出其市场经济效益，并认为工程成功最终需要与市场接轨。

• **对太阳能技术的批评和质疑**：
  ◦ [Biologist123] 提出疑问，认为文章未讨论可再生能源增长是否超过碳预算的消耗，并对仅强调积极面的报道持怀疑态度，认为这是情绪操控。
  ◦ [arh5451] 指出文章未解决太阳能生产与消费不匹配的问题，并提到中国通过国家支持主导太阳能市场的问题。
  ◦ [ryukoposting] 批评文章过于乐观，特别指出文章对能源生产分散化的论述与现实不符，因中国在太阳能生产中的主导地位。

• **对太阳能与其他能源技术的比较**：
  ◦ [coldspoon95] 强烈批评太阳能技术，认为其效率低，并与其他能源（如核能）比较，主张下一代核反应堆（如熔盐反应堆）才是更好的解决方案，特别是在能源回报和应用广度上。

补充讨论：
• **太阳能技术的现实应用**：
  ◦ [ambientenv] 引用其他文章，指出太阳能技术虽然有进展，但现实中仍有挑战，未完全乐观。
  
• **对文章内容和获取的讨论**：
  ◦ [joshdavham] 和 [peterpost2] 关注文章的获取问题，提到付费墙的存在。
  
• **对太阳能历史和意义的简短评论**：
  ◦ [Aardwolf] 幽默地指出太阳能的重要性并非今天才出现，而是自古以来就存在的。

争议焦点：
• 太阳能技术是否被过度乐观报道，尤其是忽略其潜在问题和限制。
• 太阳能与其他能源技术（如核能）的效率比较及其在未来能源结构中的角色。
• 中国在太阳能市场的主导地位及其对全球能源格局的影响。

People have been telling stories about renewable energy since the nineteen-seventies, when the first all-solar-powered house opened on the campus of the University of Delaware, drawing a hundred thousand visitors in 1973, its first year, to marvel at its early photovoltaic panels and its solar hot-water system, complete with salt tubs in the basement to store heat overnight. But, even though we’ve got used to seeing solar panels and wind turbines across the landscape in the intervening fifty years, we continue to think of what they produce as “alternative energy,” a supplement to the fossil-fuelled power that has run Western economies for more than two centuries. In the past two years, however, with surprisingly little notice, renewable energy has suddenly become the obvious, mainstream, cost-efficient choice around the world. Against all the big bad things happening on the planet (and despite all the best efforts of the Republican-led Congress in recent weeks), this is a very big and hopeful thing, which a short catalogue of recent numbers demonstrates:
It took from the invention of the photovoltaic solar cell, in 1954, until 2022 for the world to install a terawatt of solar power; the second terawatt came just two years later, and the third will arrive either later this year or early next.
That’s because people are now putting up a gigawatt’s worth of solar panels, the rough equivalent of the power generated by one coal-fired plant, every fifteen hours. Solar power is now growing faster than any power source in history, and it is closely followed by wind power—which is really another form of energy from the sun, since it is differential heating of the earth that produces the wind that turns the turbines.
Last year, ninety-six per cent of the global demand for new electricity was met by renewables, and in the United States ninety-three per cent of new generating capacity came from solar, wind, and an ever-increasing variety of batteries to store that power.
In March, for the first time, fossil fuels generated less than half the electricity in the U.S. In California, at one point on May 25th, renewables were producing a record hundred and fifty-eight per cent of the state’s power demand. Over the course of the entire day, they produced eighty-two per cent of
the power in California
, which, this spring, surpassed Japan to become the world’s fourth-largest economy.
Meanwhile, battery-storage capability has increased seventy-six per cent, based on this year’s projected estimates; at night, those batteries are often the main supplier of California’s electricity. As the director of reliability analysis at the North American Electric Reliability Corporation put it, in the
CleanTechnica
newsletter, “batteries can smooth out some of that variability from those times when the wind isn’t blowing or the sun isn’t shining.” As a result, California is so far using forty per cent less natural gas to generate electricity than it did in 2023, which is the single most hopeful statistic I’ve seen in four decades of writing about the climate crisis.
Texas is now installing renewable energy and batteries faster than California; in a single week in March, it set records for solar and wind production as well as for battery discharge. In May, when the state was hit by a near-record-breaking early-season heat wave, air-conditioners helped create a record demand on the grid, which didn’t blink—more than a quarter of the power came from the sun and wind. Last week’s flooding tragedy was a reminder of how vulnerable the state is to extreme weather, especially as water temperatures rise in the Gulf, producing more moisture in the air; in late June, the director of the state’s utility system said that the chances of emergency outages had dropped from sixteen per cent last summer to less than one per cent this year, mostly because the state had added ten thousand megawatts of solar power and battery storage. That, he said, “puts us in a better position.”
All this is dwarfed by what’s happening in China, which currently installs more than half the world’s renewable energy and storage within its own borders, and exports most of the solar panels and batteries used by the rest of the world. In May, according to government records, China had installed a record ninety-three gigawatts of solar power—amounting to a gigawatt every eight hours. The pace was apparently paying off—analysts reported that, in the first quarter of the year, total carbon emissions in China had actually decreased; emissions linked to producing electricity fell nearly six per cent, as solar and wind have replaced coal. In 2024, almost half the automobiles sold in China, which is the world’s largest car market, were full or hybrid electric vehicles. And China’s prowess at producing cheap solar panels (and E.V.s) means that nations with which it has strong trading links—in Asia, Africa, South America—are seei

主要讨论点：文档管理在技术团队中的挑战及解决方案

不同观点：
• **al_borland**：认为让人们关心文档是最难的部分。最具备编写文档能力的人往往最不关心，因为自己不需要。大组织中这个问题尤其严重。文档平台的频繁更换和他人随意删除文档让他对编写文档失去动力。

• **koliber**：强调文档维护没有捷径，必须由专人管理。文档难以查找的问题可以通过多处链接相关文档来解决，并提供了一个关于文档最佳实践的文章链接。

• **tra3**：认为文档问题本质上是知识管理问题，即使在使用Confluence等工具时，自己仍然会遇到查找困难，尝试使用AI搜索但效果不如预期。

• **nlpnerd**：指出知识管理失败的常见原因是人为疏忽，特别是在大型组织中，很多知识是“部落知识”，难以文档化。LLM等技术在短期实验中有效，但难以长期维持。

• **dhussoe**：更信任代码内文档和命令行帮助文档，认为这些在变更时更容易被更新，而wiki类文档容易腐烂。

• **Rastonbury**：认为问题在于强制记录“部落知识”，即使有搜索工具，如果知识未被记录，搜索也无济于事。LLM无法解决这一问题。

• **red-iron-pine**：认为Confluence通常管理不善，唯一见过有效的文档系统是在一个MSP公司，每个经理都将“文档准确性”作为考核指标。

• **yamatokaneko**：认为问题不在工具本身，而在公司是否重视文档。未来可能依赖自动捕捉和AI搜索，而不是手动输入和文件夹系统。

• **ferguess_k**：指出其工作过的公司都缺乏良好文档，认为需要专门人员负责编写文档，或依赖代码注释。

• **aidanferguson**：通过GPT辅助搜索在大公司文档中查找信息，虽然不理想但优于直接导航复杂的文档层级。

• **muzani**：认为Confluence是其团队中最好的工具，搜索功能较好，相比GDocs更有效。

• **brudgers**：质疑文档问题是否已被解决，提到StackOverflow的初衷就是为了更好地呈现信息。

• **lhmiles**：建议使用Google API和postgres等技术手段来增强文档搜索和存储。

• **flawstick**：认为中型公司文档问题取决于公司文化，而大型公司由于信息量过大，文档系统往往难以管理和导航。

补充讨论：
- 文档管理的核心争议在于如何让团队成员主动关心和维护文档，以及如何有效组织和查找文档。
- 不同的工具（如Confluence、GDocs、wiki）各有优缺点，但成功的关键似乎在于公司文化和制度支持。
- 新兴技术如LLM和AI搜索被视为潜在解决方案，但目前仍存在局限性。

data.title: Epanet-JS
data.author: surprisetalk
data.article_summary: EpANet-js是一款结合现代网络地图和EPANET液压模拟算法的网页应用，专为规划和更新水务系统设计。该工具由Iterating团队开发，利用了Tom MacWright此前发布的开放源代码工具Placemark的部分代码，并对其进行了改进和贡献。EpANet-js的核心库也已开源，并在功能性源代码许可证下发布，新代码贡献将在两年后开源。该工具在浏览器中运行，使用WASM引擎进行完整模拟，与昂贵的传统软件形成鲜明对比，提供了极大的改进。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕开源水力建模软件epanet-js的讨论，包括其与商业软件的对比、许可证模式、应用场景以及商业模式的争议。

不同观点：
• **支持开源和低成本方案**：lbutler和xnx对商业软件（如Autodesk和Bentley）的高价和封闭性表示不满，认为epanet-js提供了一种经济实惠且开放的替代方案，尤其是在其价格仅为商业软件的10%的情况下。xnx特别强调了epanet-js的跨平台能力和免费软件的优势。

• **许可证模式的疑问**：bilekas对epanet-js采用的FSL许可证模式表示不解，特别是其在两年后才转为MIT许可证的具体含义。

• **应用场景的拓展**：
  ◦ **游戏开发的可能性**：stared提出了是否可以用epanet-js创建类似SimCity的浏览器游戏的想法。
  ◦ **小型项目应用**：jannes则关心是否可以将该软件用于小型项目，如家庭花园的灌溉系统设计。

• **商业模式的争议**：
  ◦ **对定价策略的质疑**：PoissonVache质疑epanet-js的定价策略，建议是否可以采用更低的月费模式，并询问其公司如何平衡开源和商业利益。

补充讨论：
• **技术性能反馈**：vinnymac对epanet-js在老旧手机上的良好表现表示赞赏，尽管其移动支持仍在预览阶段。

• **文化差异的评论**：cab404的评论（"ne doljno!" 意为 "不应该！"）可能暗示了对项目开放性或定价的不同文化视角，但未提供具体理由。

• **对EPANET及其应用的认识**：iachilo表示首次了解到EPANET及其专用软件，认为这是新的知识，显示了对该领域软件需求的认识。

• **GIS系统的综合性**：jalk提出了市政使用GIS系统包含所有基础设施（如供水、电力、通信等）的疑问，探讨了这些系统是否缺乏模拟功能。

争议焦点：
• 商业软件高价和封闭性 vs 开源和低成本方案的优劣。
• epanet-js的FSL许可证模式的具体含义和影响。
• epanet-js的定价策略是否合理，以及如何平衡开源和商业利益。

44464628.article_content:
epanet-js
epanet-js
is a new web application that combines modern web maps with the industry-standard
EPANET
hydraulic simulation algorithm. It’s for people planning and updating water utility systems: connecting pipes and pressures and figuring out what will happen. It’s a problem area that I’m totally fascinated by and know very little about. It’s made by the folks from
Iterating
- Luke Butler and Sam Payá, who are experts in the field.
If you’ve been following along with my blog and projects, you might notice something familiar about this screenshot of epanet-js:
Yep! A lifetime ago, I built a company and product called
Placemark
, which was a tool for creating and editing map data. When the business part didn’t work out, I published a
free-to-use version of Placemark
and
made the code open source
. I chose a very permissive license for the code:
the MIT license
. I wanted to let
anything
happen, including -
especially
- people creating paid products with the code.
It’s hard to explain to people outside of the world of open source that folks building a business with the help of my code is
the dream
.
Partly it’s that ‘being helpful’ is one of the goals in life that never gets old. The other part is that
most software becomes obsolete and abandoned quickly
. Creating software with any legacy is rare and something to celebrate.
Plus, Placemark was a general purpose tool in search of a successful niche: I never figured out what that niche was. I had a lot of learning to do about product-market-fit. But hydraulic simulation is a real market, and these folks are real experts.
There are other markets like this, I’m sure, and using Placemark code as a base could be a good way to jumpstart those companies - it’s not perfect, as I’ve documented extensively, but it could be good as a first step.
And the folks at Iterating have even
contributed changes upstream to the open source Placemark
codebase, but that isn’t required by the MIT license at all: that’s just because they’re cool folks.
They’ve also
open sourced the core epanet-js library
, and released the web application
under the Functional Source License
, which
makes new code contributions open source after two years
.
</source>
And epanet-js is a tool that you can run in a browser - full simulations with a WASM-based engine. It’s competing with expensive old-school software that costs $16,000 a year, runs exclusively on Windows, is
priced by “pipes”
, and uses the same engine, EPANET. This is so much better in comparison. A radical improvement.
Congrats to Luke and Sam for creating
epanet-js
. It’s super cool. If you speak hydraulic simulation or know someone who does, try it out!
July 3, 2025
Tom MacWright
@macwright.com on Bluesky
,
@tmcw@mastodon.social on Mastodon

data.title: Why I'm skeptical of Ground News
data.author: blowenopdestoep
data.article_summary: Scott Odle对Ground News持怀疑态度，认为其在政治光谱上汇集新闻并通过"盲点"功能展示不同媒体对同一事件的报道可能导致虚假平衡。Ground News根据新闻来源的偏见和事实性评分对媒体进行分类，并通过"盲点"突出显示报道偏向某一方的故事。作者使用Python脚本分析了2023年11月和12月的500个盲点故事，发现左倾故事的高事实性来源明显多于右倾故事，且右倾故事更多使用混合事实性和低事实性来源。作者质疑这些盲点故事是否经过良好 sourcing，以及是否存在将谎言作为某一方盲点的现象。Ground News的自动化程度和具体运作方式也缺乏透明度，进一步引发对其可信度的担忧。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Ground News平台在呈现左右翼新闻时的平衡性和可信度问题

不同观点：
• [antifa] 认为Ground News平台上右翼新闻的可信度较低，但平台却将这些新闻与左翼或中间派的新闻同等对待，这会误导读者。同时担心如果平台试图解决这个问题，右翼会指责其为"假新闻"或受控于特定势力。对平台持怀疑态度，特别是考虑到YouTube赞助商常有骗局。

• [unsignedint] 认为Ground News提供了比传统单一新闻来源更广泛的视角，强调媒体素养的重要性。Blindspot功能帮助读者识别那些可能被某一方忽视或夸大的故事，但最终判断权仍在读者手中。平台的历史数据和媒体所有权信息有助于读者做出更明智的判断。

• [oldandboring] 理解作者对右翼故事被作为左翼盲点呈现的担忧，但认为这正是Ground News的目的所在，即让读者自行判断故事的可信度。平台通过展示某一方忽视的故事，帮助读者在其他场合识别这些故事，从而提高信息透明度。

• [PeterStuer] 讽刺左翼作者认为左翼新闻来源通常比右翼更可靠的观点，暗示这是一种常见的偏见。

• [riskable] 认为Ground News的算法过度信任右翼新闻的可信度，建议改进算法以对右翼来源进行更严格审查，甚至建议删除低事实评级的右翼新闻来源。提议将如NPR等视为中间派而非左翼，并批评如Breitbart等右翼网站因事实性不足应被剔除。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点在于Ground News平台如何处理和呈现左右翼新闻的平衡，特别是右翼新闻的低事实性问题。
• 读者自主判断与平台算法推荐之间的责任分配是另一个讨论要点。
• 对新闻来源的政治倾向和事实性评级的定义和处理方式存在不同看法。

44507332.article_content:
scoott.blog
Why I'm skeptical of Ground News
Scott Odle • Thursday, January 18, 2024
Ground News
↗
is a website and mobile app, aiming to “offer clarity in an increasingly chaotic media landscape”.
It collects articles from thousands of news sources across the political spectrum, and groups them into “stories,” showing how different media outlets cover the same event differently.
According to the About page, the site is managed by a team of 18 people in Waterloo, Ontario.
Ground News has recently begun to sponsor several creators on YouTube and other platforms.
These creators are often politically left-of-center, but many educational channels have also begun promoting the site.
How does Ground News work?
Each of Ground’s news sources is prominently labeled with Bias and Factuality ratings.
According to the
Methodology
↗
page, these ratings are sourced from numerous independent rating agencies.
Bias ratings span seven categories, from “Far Left” to “Center” to “Far Right”. Factuality ratings can be either “Low”, “Mixed”, or “High”.
Some sources are also categorized based on their ownership, which is researched independently by the Ground News team.
All of this data is used to deliver Ground News’ most prominent feature, Blindspot.
Blindspot highlights stories where coverage skews drastically towards one side or other of the political spectrum.
Blindspot stories aggregate all the available sources for an event, and present them beneath a unified title and summary.
For many larger stories, the summary is available from “Left”, “Center”, and “Right” perspectives, and a “Bias Insights” feature details the differences in coverage across difference perspectives.
For example,
this story
↗
discusses a lingering impact of 2021’s Hurricane Larry, which deposited a large amount of microplastic particles over Newfoundland.
This story is labeled as a Blindspot for the right, because 60% of its coverage comes from left-leaning sources.
It is unclear how Ground News aggregates these stories together, or how the title, summary, and Bias Insights are generated.
Based on the volume of stories that Ground handles each day, proportional to the size of their team, I came to the assumption that this is done using AI, or some other type of automated process.
This assumption is strengthened by the “Insights by Ground AI” banner that appears on most stories.
However, there is no confirmation that this is the case, nor any explanation of how the app actually works.
Looking for false balance on Ground News
False balance is a form of media bias, where well-established facts and research are presented alongside an “opposing point of view.”
The opposing viewpoint has less evidence to back it up, but gets presented with the same weight, giving the illusion that a story is neutral and unbiased.
Carlos Maza gave a
TEDxCUNY talk
↗
in 2019, where he explained false balance and its effects quite compellingly.
Conceptually, Ground’s Blindspot stories seem like a place where false balance and other biases would easily creep in.
After exploring their site for a bit, I have two questions:
Are Blindspot stories well-sourced, whether they’re left-leaning or right-leaning? If not, does one side lie more than the other?
Are there any examples of an outright lie being presented as a Blindspot for one side or the other?
To answer these questions, I used a Python script to retrieve 500 Blindspots from November and December of 2023.
264 of these stories were tagged as Blindspots for the left, meaning that their coverage skews towards the right.
The remaining 236 were presented as right-wing Blindspots, meaning that their coverage is mostly left-leaning.
Question 1: Factuality across the political divide
Overall source quality
First off, I counted the number of sources in each Blindspot story, grouped by their Factuality rating.
This chart shows the average quality and quantity of sources, for Blindspot stories on each side of the aisle.
Stories from both sides tend to have a similar number of sources (17.7 on average for left-leaning stories, and 16.4 for right-leaning ones).
However, the quality of sources varies drastically:
Left-leaning stories have far more high-factuality sources: 10.9 on average, compared to 2.7 for the right.
The majority of sources for right-leaning stories are rated as “mixed factuality”. Ground News points out that mixed-factuality sources might:
“not always use proper sourcing"
"use loaded language that alters the context of facts"
"fail to correct false or misleading information”

data.title: LookingGlass: Generative Anamorphoses via Laplacian Pyramid Warping
data.author: jw1224
data.article_summary: 《LookingGlass: Generative Anamorphoses via Laplacian Pyramid Warping》一文介绍了一种生成变形图像的新方法。传统的变形图像（Anamorphosis）只有在特定视角下才能显示其真实形态，而本文通过使用潜在校正流模型，提出了一种即使直接观看也能保持有效解释的变形图像生成技术。文中引入了拉普拉斯金字塔变形（Laplacian Pyramid Warping）方法，这是一种频谱感知的图像变形技术，有助于生成高质量的视觉效果。该方法将视觉谜题（Visual Anagrams）扩展到潜在空间模型，并支持更广泛的空间变换，从而创造出新颖的生成感知 illusion。

44495154.article_content:
LookingGlass: Generative Anamorphoses via Laplacian Pyramid Warping
In this work, we revisit these famous optical illusions with a generative twist. With the help of latent rectified flow models, we propose a method to create anamorphic images that still retain a valid interpretation when viewed directly.
June 10, 2025
CVPR 2025
Authors
Pascal Chang (DisneyResearch|Studios/ETH Joint PhD)
Sergio Sancho (DisneyResearch|Studios/ETH Joint PhD)
Jingwei Tang (DisneyResearch|Studios)
Markus Gross (DisneyResearch|Studios)
Vinicius Azevedo (DisneyResearch|Studios)
LookingGlass: Generative Anamorphoses via Laplacian Pyramid Warping
Download Publication PDF
Download Supplemental PDF
Abstract
Anamorphosis refers to a category of images that are intentionally distorted, making them unrecognizable when viewed directly. Their true form only reveals itself when seen from a specific viewpoint, which can be through some catadioptric device like a mirror or a lens. While the construction of these mathematical devices can be traced back to as early as the 17th century, they are only interpretable when viewed from a specific vantage point and tend to lose meaning when seen normally. In this paper, we revisit these famous optical illusions with a generative twist. With the help of latent rectified flow models, we propose a method to create anamorphic images that still retain a valid interpretation when viewed directly. To this end, we introduce Laplacian Pyramid Warping, a frequency-aware image warping technique key to generating high-quality visuals. Our work extends Visual Anagrams to latent space models and to a wider range of spatial transforms, enabling the creation of novel generative perceptual illusions.

《AI Agent革命：AI代理掌控代码》一文介绍了AI代理在软件工具中的兴起，特别是在数据科学领域的应用。文章指出，尽管GitHub的Copilot、亚马逊的CodeWhisperer等工具越来越流行，但它们大多无法直接在笔记本内核中运行。MLJAR Studio填补了这一空白，它内置AI代理，可以在笔记本中像真实队友一样工作，编写和解释代码，帮助学习。

MLJAR Studio提供三种模式：
1. **数据分析师模式**：无需编码，AI代理通过数据完成分析和机器学习任务。
2. **代码助手模式**：用户用英语描述需求，AI代理生成Python代码。
3. **教师模式**：互动教学，通过选择题学习代码。

使用AI代理可以加快数据处理速度，帮助学习代码，并确保数据隐私和安全。MLJAR Studio实现了AI代理与笔记本的无缝集成，是数据科学工作的未来工具。

44508798.article_content:
AI Agent Revolution
AI Agents take control of our code
Aleksandra Płońska
4 min read
·
Just now
--
Listen
Share
It
happens right now: AI Agents are becoming increasingly popular. AI-powered assistants are becoming the norm across software tools, especially in data science. GitHub has Copilot, Amazon offers CodeWhisperer, and tools like Hex and Deepnote embed AI into notebooks.
But most of these tools still fall short in one crucial area:
They don't
directly work inside your notebook kernel
, where your data lives and where your code runs.
That's where
MLJAR Studio
changes the game.
What Was Missing in Classic Notebooks?
Jupyter notebooks are incredibly flexible, but they lack one crucial feature:
👉 an
AI assistant that actually understands and executes your code
, knows your variables and works
locally
on your machine.
That missing piece is now here.
MLJAR Studio comes with a
built-in AI Agent
that works
inside your notebook
, like a real teammate. It writes code, analyzes data, explains results, and helps you learn — right where you need it.
AI Agent panel in MLJAR Studio
3 Modes of the AI Agent in MLJAR Studio
MLJAR Studio offers
three distinct modes
to match your workflow. Whether you're coding, exploring data, or learning, there's a mode for you.
📊 Data Analyst Mode
This mode helps data analysts with their tasks. With a Data Analyst Agent, you can
perform complicated analysis and machine learning tasks without coding
or knowledge of Python. Just by using your data, you can achieve results without coding skills.
Ask data questions — no code shown. The Agent explores, visualizes, and summarizes the results. You stay focused on insights, not syntax.
The notebook still stores all the code in the background.
📌
Prompt:
"Which product category grew fastest in Q2?" 💡
Output:
Chart + summary, no code displayed
💻 Code Assistant Mode
This mode is perfect for saving time. If you know the Python syntax and want
full control over the executed code
, this mode will fit your needs.
You write a prompt in plain English. The Agent returns clean Python code. You choose when to run it. You decide whether to use the suggested code snippet or write it yourself.
📌
Prompt:
"Plot sales by region for the past 12 months." 💡
Output:
Full code snippet
🎓 Teacher Mode
An interactive tutor that helps users truly learn, the Agent
reveals only part of the code snippet
, while the rest is offered as a multiple-choice exercise (A/B/C). You chose the correct answer. Learn by doing — get explanations after each choice.
Perfect for beginners and interactive learning.
📌
Prompt:
"Show me how groupby works." 💡
Output:
Code quiz with a hint and explanation
AI Agent modes
How to start?
You begin by choosing one of three modes: data analyst, code assistant, or teacher. Next, you type a question or instruction using plain English.
Example:
"Create a scatter plot of income vs. age grouped by gender."
The AI Agent reads your notebook's state, including defined variables, data frames, imports, and prior cells. It adjusts the response to your current context.
How output is generated is defined by the chosen mode. AI Agent can:
return Python code for you to run,
show a chart or summary directly, or
present a learning quiz with choices.
All actions are transparent and logged inside the notebook, so you stay in control.
AI Agent — Data Analyst Mode
Why Work with the AI Agent?
Using the AI Agent in MLJAR Studio makes working with data faster and easier. You can write simple instructions in plain English, and the Agent will generate working Python code for you in just a few seconds. This is especially helpful when you're exploring data or building machine learning models. The Agent also helps you learn while you work — you can see how the code works on real data and understand each step. If something goes wrong, the Agent can look at the error message and suggest how to fix it. You don't have to spend time searching for solutions — the Agent helps right away. It can also create charts and summaries directly, so you can focus on insights instead of writing code. All of this happens on your computer, so your data stays private and secure. Plus, the Agent uses good coding practices and helps you avoid common mistakes, which makes your work more reliable.
Ready for the revolution?
AI Agents are the future of coding, but
MLJAR Studio
is already there.
With three unique modes and seamless integration in your notebook, you can generate code, analyze data, and learn Python all in one place.
It's fast. It's private. It's built for data science.
Try MLJAR Studio — and bring your notebook to life with AI.

data.title: Thesis: Interesting work is less amenable to the use of AI
data.author: koch
data.article_summary: 文章作者Rob Koch提出了一个观点：有趣且有价值的工作相较于无趣的工作，更不容易被人工智能（AI）取代。他提到，虽然很多人称赞AI提高了生产力，但他认为如果将自己的工作完全交给大型语言模型（LLM），会失去上下文理解，并违背“专一做好一件事”的原则。Koch质疑那些经常编写样板代码（boilerplate）的软件工程师工作的价值，认为这样的工作不仅效率低下，而且容易被取代。他强调，软件工程师的核心应是解决问题，而非仅仅匹配样板代码。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：LLM（大型语言模型）在工作中的实际应用价值、伦理问题以及对人类工作的影响

不同观点：
• overgard：认为LLM无法真正进行推理，其生成内容类似于“高级自动抄袭”，尤其在使用开源软件训练的情况下。他质疑LLM的伦理问题，因为无法像使用传统资源一样明确给予信用。同时，他认为LLM对重复性工作有用，但在创造性或独特性任务上作用有限。
• janaagaard：通过实际案例说明LLM生成内容需要大量的事实核查，即使明确提示它不要编造信息。他认为使用LLM的过程（如事实核查）可能是有趣的，但LLM本身不能替代人类创造性工作。
• keiferski：将AI工具视为扩展知识和创意的助手，而非直接生成最终产品的工具。他强调AI在研究和编辑中的价值，而不是写作本身，从而更加宽容其输出的错误。
• orochiмаaru：认为AI主要针对处理和管理大量已知知识，帮助处理常规任务，而非替代创新或原创思维。专家能够更有效地利用AI，而缺乏专业知识的人可能会被其误导。
• viccis：LLM在从零开始构建项目时非常有用，但在处理复杂、技术债务或跨团队决策时效果不佳。他指出，初创企业可能过度依赖LLM，忽略了技术审查和调整的必要性。
• ianbicking：认为AI可以在多种工作中发挥作用，尤其是通过辅助研究工具帮助理解背景和历史，从而使工作更加有趣和丰富。
• JimDabell：提出AI处理简单任务可以让人类专注于更困难的任务，从而使工作整体更有趣。

Thesis: interesting work (i.e., work worth doing) is less amenable to the use of AI than ... non-interesting work.
I have to admit that I get a little FOMO when I see people on HN laude the use of AI and how much more productive it's making them. Meanwhile, I feel like if I tried to offload my work to an LLM, I would both lose context and be violating the do-one-thing-and-do-it-well principle I half-heartedly try to live by.
I don't mean to disparage anyone working on boilerplate, it's something we all have to do, but at the same time that's just not what I'm doing. Or at least, that's not what I'm spending most of my time on. Why would someone be writing boilerplate all the time? How is that not, even without LLMs, a failure of efficiency? Why would you think your boilerplate-writing job would be secure?
Have I been misunderstanding what a lot of software engineers do, or think they do? I thought we solved problems. I didn't think we just matched boilerplate to feature requests, merely the last worker in the assembly line of idea manifestation.
Cheers

Abstract:
We present Mercury, a new generation of commercial-scale large language models (LLMs) based on diffusion. These models are parameterized via the Transformer architecture and trained to predict multiple tokens in parallel. In this report, we detail Mercury Coder, our first set of diffusion LLMs designed for coding applications. Currently, Mercury Coder comes in two sizes: Mini and Small. These models set a new state-of-the-art on the speed-quality frontier. Based on independent evaluations conducted by Artificial Analysis, Mercury Coder Mini and Mercury Coder Small achieve state-of-the-art throughputs of 1109 tokens/sec and 737 tokens/sec, respectively, on NVIDIA H100 GPUs and outperform speed-optimized frontier models by up to 10x on average while maintaining comparable quality. We discuss additional results on a variety of code benchmarks spanning multiple languages and use-cases as well as real-world validation by developers on Copilot Arena, where the model currently ranks second on quality and is the fastest model overall. We also release a public API at

data.title: Evolution Mail Users Easily Trackable
data.author: mike-cardwell
data.article_summary: Evolution Mail的“加载远程内容”隐私保护功能失效多年未修复。即使该选项关闭，含有特定HTML标签的邮件仍会触发DNS请求或建立连接，泄露用户是否阅读邮件及其大致位置。开发团队将问题归咎于WebKitGTK，且未有近期修复计划。作者建议，若重视隐私，应卸载Evolution Mail，因其无法保护用户隐私，且开发者不认为这是他们的责任。

44512684.article_content:
Evolution Mail Users Easily Trackable
Written an hour ago by Mike Cardwell
Evolution Mail’s “Load Remote Content” option, as a privacy protection feature doesn’t work. They know it doesn’t work. It hasn’t worked for years and there is no sign it will be fixed any time soon.
I discovered the other day that if a HTML email contains a tag like:
<link
rel
=
"dns-prefetch"
href
=
"https://trackingcode.attackersdomain.example.com"
>
Then when an email is opened in Evolution Mail, a DNS request for trackingcode.attackersdomain.example.com is performed. This happens with remote content disabled, and without clicking the button to fetch it. The sender can look at their DNS logs to see if you’ve read your email, and the IP address of your DNS resolver at that time, which may indicate your location.
I opened a
bug report
with Evolution Mail, and they blamed WebKitGTK for this situation and have closed my ticket as a
duplicate of another ticket
which was opened in April 2024. That ticket reported a different but similar bug:
<link
href
=
"trackingcode.attackersdomain.example.com"
rel
=
"preconnect"
>
This apparently triggers a connection when you read an email, even without clicking to load remote content. An attacker could look at the SNI header during the TLS negotiation to identify the unique reader of such an email, and it would grant them their IP address.
This one
links back to a webkit bug
which was opened in August 2023, which also suggests there will be other such leaks, and which shows no sign of being dealt with.
I suggested that maintaining a whitelist of allowed html tags and attributes, and stripping them before passing the email html onto a web browser would be a good defense in depth strategy, but this looks unlikely to be followed.
So my suggestion is: If you care about having privacy when reading your email, uninstall Evolution Mail. It doesn’t protect your privacy, and the devs don’t consider that to be their responsibility.

data.title: Archaeologists unveil 3,500-year-old city in Peru
data.author: neversaydie
data.article_summary: 考古学家在秘鲁北部巴兰卡省发现了一座距今3500年的古城佩尼科（Peñico），该城建于公元前1800至1500年之间，位于海拔600米的山坡上，距利马北部约200公里。佩尼科被认为是连接太平洋沿岸社区与安第斯山脉和亚马逊盆地居民的重要贸易枢纽。研究显示，该城有18座建筑，包括仪式庙宇和住宅建筑，出土文物包括仪式物品、陶土雕塑和贝壳项链。佩尼科靠近公元前3000年建立的卡拉尔文明，这一发现有助于理解卡拉尔文明在气候变化影响后的发展。考古学家Ruth Shady指出，佩尼科在贸易和文化交流中占据战略位置，是卡拉尔社会的延续。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：关于Peñico古城的发现及其意义的不同观点和讨论

不同观点：
• [gregsadetsky] 提供了有关Peñico城的链接和基本信息，但没有发表明确观点，仅提供了参考资料。
• [slimebot80] 质疑为何花了8年时间才发掘出古城，尤其是根据照片似乎很明显。他怀疑8年前古城是否真的被埋没。
• [Aspos] 表达了对误用"decimated"一词为"destroyed"的非理性厌恶，但没有直接讨论古城本身，而是关注语言使用的问题。
• [tree_enjoyer] 认为将Peñico称为美洲最古老的文明是过于夸张的说法，指出有证据显示在更早的时间里美洲已有其他人类居住的痕迹。他提出，尽管这些早期居民没有建造像Olmec那样的巨石结构，但仍有未被发掘的文明存在于南美丛林中。

补充讨论：
• [adolph] 质疑是否有新的研究成果未被报道，指出在Google Scholar上没有找到相关研究人员的最新出版物。他还提到8年的研究发现了18个结构，包括宗教仪式用的寺庙和居住建筑群，质疑是否有新的发现被遗漏或误解。
• 争议的焦点在于Peñico城是否真的需要8年时间来发掘，以及它是否能被称为美洲最古老的文明。tree_enjoyer和adolph的观点显示了对当前研究结论的怀疑，认为可能有更多未被揭示的历史秘密。

总结：讨论围绕Peñico城的发掘时间、其作为最古老文明的称号以及研究成果的真实性和完整性展开。各方对研究结论和媒体报道的准确性存在一定争议。

44487451.article_content:
Image source,
Reuters
Jessica Rawnsley
BBC News
Published
6 July 2025
Archaeologists have announced the discovery of an ancient city in Peru's northern Barranca province.
The 3,500-year-old city, named PeÃ±ico, is believed to have served as a key trading hub connecting early Pacific coast communities with those living in the Andes mountains and Amazon basin.
Located some 200km north of Lima, the site lies about 600 metres (1,970 feet) above sea level and is thought to have been founded between 1,800 and 1,500 BC - around the same time that early civilisations were flourishing in the Middle East and Asia.
Researchers say the discovery sheds light on what became of the Americas' oldest civilisation, the Caral.
Image source,
Reuters
Image caption,
An aerial view of the archaeological zone of PeÃ±ico, in Peru, an ancient city established 3,500 years ago
Drone footage released by researchers shows a circular structure on a hillside terrace at the city's centre, surrounded by the remains of stone and mud buildings.
Eight years of research at the site unearthed 18 structures, including ceremonial temples and residential complexes.
In buildings at the site, researchers discovered ceremonial objects, clay sculptures of human and animal figures and necklaces made from beads and seashells.
PeÃ±ico is situated close to where Caral, recognised as the oldest known civilisation in the Americas, was established 5,000 years ago at around 3,000 BC in the Supe valley of Peru.
Caral features 32 monuments, including large pyramid structures, sophisticated irrigation agriculture and urban settlements. It is believed to have developed in isolation to other comparative early civilisations in India, Egypt, Sumeria and China.
Dr Ruth Shady, the archaeologist who led the recent research into PeÃ±ico and the excavation of Caral in the 1990s, said that the discovery was important for understanding what became of the Caral civilisation after it was decimated by climate change.
The PeÃ±ico community was "situated in a strategic location for trade, for exchange with societies from the coast, the highlands and the jungle", Dr Shady told the Reuters news agency.
At a news conference unveiling the findings on Thursday, archaeologist Marco Machacuay, a researcher with the Ministry of Culture, said that PeÃ±ico's significance lies in it being a continuation of the Caral society.
Peru is home to many of the Americas' most significant archaeological discoveries, including the Inca citadel of Machu Picchu in the Andes and the mysterious Nazca Lines etched into the desert along the central coast.

data.title: Show HN: FlopperZiro – A DIY open-source Flipper Zero clone
data.author: iraton
data.article_summary: FlopperZiro是一个开源、低成本、可自行DIY的Flipper Zero克隆项目，使用Arduino IDE进行编程。项目硬件包括STM32微控制器、RF收发模块、PN532/PN7150 RFID/NFC模块、OLED显示屏、红外收发器等组件。它支持RubberDucky、RFID/NFC、IR、RF等功能，可通过SD卡保存/加载数据，并显示电池及存储剩余百分比。软件方面仍在开发中，包括解决SD卡和显示问题、完善菜单及功能。项目提供3D打印外壳设计，硬件PCB也在持续改进。FlopperZiro是一个趣味项目，不具备专业设备的功能。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：LilyGo T-Embed CC1100与Flipper Zero的比较及其相关技术特性

不同观点：
• **性价比与功能对比**：boznz认为LilyGo T-Embed在硬件上与Flipper Zero相似，且具有WiFi/蓝牙功能，运行Bruce Pentest firmware，价格不到Flipper Zero的一半。虽然Bruce firmware不如Flipper Zero的软件完善，但两者都是开源的，易于修改。

• **软件支持与社区**：Chihuahua0633质疑LilyGo T-Embed和Capibara Zero是否有与Flipper Zero相同的软件支持，并指出Flipper Zero背后强大的社区支持是其受欢迎的重要因素。

• **RF功能限制**：Neywiny指出LilyGo T-Embed在RF功能上的局限性，认为它主要是433 MHz的重放攻击设备，功能相对简化，不能与Flipper Zero的广泛功能相比。

• **设备外观与设计**：s-mon对Defcon会议上该设备可能引发的反应表示好奇。the__alchemist则对设备的PCB设计提出质疑，认为将多个开发板焊接到一个大PCB上的做法令人费解。

• **便携性与供电**：conradev对设备能否通过现代智能手机供电表示好奇，并提到Flipper的体积和充电需求是个问题。

• **外观与名称**：aitacobell以幽默的方式提到设备外观，而macawfish则表示喜欢设备的名称。

• **市场与文化影响**：zeroq指出Flipper Zero的一个吸引力在于其文化影响力，拥有它能带来某种身份认同和社交媒体上的关注。

补充讨论：
• **隐私与安全性**：forgetbook对Flipper Zero可能存在的隐私问题（如设备回传数据）表示担忧。

• **市场竞争与仿制品**：anfractuosity询问是否有人见过AliExpress上Flipper Zero的仿制品，而karolist提到了Capibara Zero作为一个替代选项。

• **期待与幽默**：vsviridov以幽默的方式表达了对未来类似设备FlopperOne的期待。

• **特定功能期待**：kevo1ution对NFC支持表示兴奋。

总体来看，讨论围绕设备的功能、性价比、社区支持、设计和市场影响展开，部分参与者对设备的局限性提出批评，而其他人则对其潜力表示期待。隐私与安全性也成为讨论中的一个关注点。

"JUST FUCKING SHIP IT" (or: on vibecoding)
07/09/25
because some people simply shouldn't be allowed to use the internet
Preface
I have minimal experience with exploitation or security research- some techniques employed in this write-up are almost certainly suboptimal. This is not a tutorial, do not treat it as such. Sensitive information has been censored as best as possible.
Introduction
Earlier in the year I attended a hackathon organized by my university's IEEE branch. My team and I managed to hack together a pretty decent submission, and for our efforts, we were rewarded with
second place
. Among the submissions, a one
Mentora
piqued my interest. Mentora marketed itself as an "AI tutor", seeking to gamify quizzes and provide personalized lesson plans using, you guessed it, large language models.
Interested, I began to explore the "How we built it" section of the Devpost. React Native, Supabase, and OpenAI integration. Yup! This
reeks
of vibe coder slop. Unfortunately, Mentora never seemed to see the light of day. Luckily,
our hero
didn't stop there, and this time he's breaking into the social media market. Enter:
Pandu
.
What even is Pandu?
Much like Mentora, Pandu is a pretty generic take on an existing genre
but with more AI slop
. Disappointingly, there is yet to be an Android release of Pandu, and given that I don't own any Apple devices, investigating this might be a little rough.
First Steps
Apparently, Apple's
IPA
format is encrypted, meaning that blindly pulling files from a server and expecting to be able to read them isn't going to work. Luckily, someone has managed to automate this process of decrypting these bundles and has even been so kind as to expose the tooling behind a Telegram bot.
After acquiring the decrypted IPA, I simply suffixed the file with
.zip
and extracted it:
unzip
pandu_ipa_v103.ipa.zip
The archive yielded a
Payload/
folder, with the following structure:
The main file of interest here is the
main.jsbundle
, which appears to be a JavaScript bundle compiled with Hermes. After a quick pass with
hermes-dec
, I was left with a mostly readable blob of pseudocode:
python
hbc_decompiler.py ./Payload/Pandu.app/main.jsbundle pandu_decomp.js
Initial Investigation
I began my search by looking for very low-hanging fruit. Surely an app published on the App Store wouldn't expose an OpenAI key, right?
grep
"
'sk-
"
pandu_decomp.js
r11 = 'sk-proj-*************************************************';
WHAT? There. Is. No. Way.
curl
"
https://api.openai.com/v1/responses
"
\
-
H
"
Content-Type: application/json
"
\
-
H
"
Authorization: Bearer sk-proj-********
"
\
-
s
\
-
d
'
{
"model": "gpt-4.1",
"input": "Write me a haiku about why it is not a great idea to hard-code OpenAI API keys into client-facing applications."
}
'
|
jq
-
r
'
.output[0].content[0].text
'
Secrets in plain sight—
Exposed keys invite misuse,
Guard doors, don’t paint signs.
So it turns out that all the fancy LLM integration is handled client-side, with the users' device issuing the OpenAI API queries and forwarding the output to the "backend" (if you can even call it that, I'll get to this later).
Now that we know that LLM queries are handled client-side, it shouldn't be too difficult to pull out the system prompt.
An LLM prompt isn't exactly "valuable information," and "prompt engineering" is most definitely not a skill- Nonetheless I'm expecting this to be quite funny.
"You are a Gen Z App, You are Pandu,you are helping a user spark conversations with a new user, you are not cringe and you are not too forward, be human-like. You generate 1 short, trendy, and fun conversation starter. It should be under 100 characters and should not be unfinished. It should be tailored to the user's vibe or profile info. Keep it casual or playful and really gen z use slangs and emojis. No Quotation mark"
I wonder what prompted him to tell the model not to be cringe.
Supabase
If you aren't familiar, Supabase is a
Backend-as-a-Service
, providing CRUD-accessible endpoints, a database, storage buckets, authentication, and even real-time communication. The upside of something like this is that you don't need to understand the complexities that come with backend development in order to build something that "just works". However, you'll later come to see that this is also a hidden downside, as some people shouldn't be permitted within 10 feet of a backend.
Taking the place of a standard database, Supabase expects the client to talk directly to the database- now, you might be thinking to yourself: "isn't that a horrible idea?" and to your question, I'll reply "yes." The assumption is that the person in charge of configuring Supabase will correctly dish out permissions such that end-users cannot simply read/write to arbitrary relations, but as you'll soon see, this is not always the case.
With the decompiled pseudocode in hand, it was as simple as grepping for a few keywords:
function
(
...
)
{
...
r1
=

data.article_summary: 本文介绍了一种新的宇宙学流体动力学模拟方法，基于移动非结构化网格（Voronoi网格），解决了传统方法如SPH和AMR在处理流体不稳定性、伽利略不变性和过度混合方面的不足。该方法采用有限体积法和二阶Godunov方案，具备自动调整空间分辨率的能力，兼具SPH和Eulerian方法的优点。新方法在处理冲击波和接触不连续性方面表现优异，并通过AREPO代码实现了2D和3D的并行计算。文章还讨论了自引力处理和网格自适应细化技术，展示了新方法在多个测试问题上的高精度表现，证明其在宇宙学模拟中具有竞争优势。

44490848.article_content:
Paper
arXiv:0901.4107
E pur si muove:
Galiliean-invariant cosmological hydrodynamical simulations on a moving
mesh
Authors:
Volker
Springel
(MPA)
Comments:
accepted in
MNRAS, 67 pages, 50 figures.
Hydrodynamic cosmological simulations at present usually employ either
the Lagrangian smoothed particle hydrodynamics (SPH) technique, or
Eulerian hydrodynamics on a Cartesian mesh with (optional) adaptive
mesh refinement (AMR).  Both of these methods have
disadvantages
that negatively impact their accuracy in certain situations,
for
example the suppression of fluid instabilities in the case of SPH, and
the lack of Galilean-invariance and the presence of overmixing in the
case of AMR.  We here propose a novel scheme which largely
eliminates these weaknesses. It is based on a moving unstructured mesh
defined by the Voronoi tessellation of a set of discrete points. The
mesh is used to solve the hyperbolic conservation laws of ideal
hydrodynamics with a finite volume approach, based on a second-order
unsplit Godunov scheme with an exact Riemann solver. The
mesh-generating points can in principle be moved arbitrarily. If they
are chosen to be stationary, the scheme is equivalent to an ordinary
Eulerian method with second order accuracy. If they instead move with
the velocity of the local flow, one obtains a Lagrangian formulation of
continuum hydrodynamics that does not suffer from the mesh distortion
limitations inherent in other mesh-based Lagrangian schemes. In this
mode, our new method is fully Galilean-invariant, unlike ordinary
Eulerian codes, a property that is of significant importance for
cosmological simulations where highly supersonic bulk flows are
common.  In addition, the new scheme can adjust
its spatial resolution automatically and continuously, and hence
inherits the principal advantage of SPH for simulations of cosmological
structure growth. The high accuracy of Eulerian methods in the
treatment of shocks is also retained, while the treatment of contact
discontinuities improves. We discuss how this approach is implemented
in our new code AREPO, both in 2D and 3D, and is parallelized for
distributed memory computers. We also discuss techniques for adaptive
refinement or derefinement of the unstructured mesh.  We
introduce
an individual time-step approach for finite volume hydrodynamics, and
present a high-accuracy treatment of self-gravity for the gas that
allows the new method to be seamlessly combined with a high-resolution
treatment of collisionless dark matter.  We use a suite of
test
problems to examine the performance of the new code and argue that the
hydrodynamic moving-mesh scheme proposed here provides an attractive
and competitive alternative to current SPH and Eulerian techniques.

44490848.article_summary: 本文介绍了一种新的宇宙学流体动力学模拟方法，基于移动非结构化网格（Voronoi网格），解决了传统方法如SPH和AMR在处理流体不稳定性、伽利略不变性和过度混合方面的不足。该方法采用有限体积法和二阶Godunov方案，具备自动调整空间分辨率的能力，兼具SPH和Eulerian方法的优点。新方法在处理冲击波和接触不连续性方面表现优异，并通过AREPO代码实现了2D和3D的并行计算。文章还讨论了自引力处理和网格自适应细化技术，展示了新方法在多个测试问题上的高精度表现，证明其在宇宙学模拟中具有竞争优势。

data.title: Solar becomes top source of electricity in California
data.author: martinpw
data.article_summary: 在截至2025年4月的12个月中，加州的太阳能发电量首次超过天然气，成为主要电力来源。根据美国能源信息管理局的数据，太阳能发电量为83.1太瓦时，占总电力的33.9%，而天然气为81.6太瓦时，占33.3%。加州总发电量为244.9太瓦时，约三分之二来自无排放源。自2014年以来，太阳能占比从7%增至32%以上，而天然气则从59%降至33.3%。尽管天然气总发电量自2017年以来略有下降，但随着电池储能容量增加，太阳能利用率提升，天然气发电量加速下降。截至2025年4月，加州已安装超过15.7吉瓦的电池容量，在晚间高峰时段成为主要电力来源。全国范围内，太阳能发电量持续增长，4月份美国太阳能供电占比首次超过10%，而加州在4月的太阳能供电占比达42%。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：美国可再生能源（尤其是太阳能）与传统能源（如天然气）的发电量对比，以及未来能源发展趋势和应用场景。

不同观点：
• [kibwen] 认为此次太阳能发电量超过天然气发电量是一个令人意外且积极的变化，打破了以往仅在特定时段（如正午短时间内）太阳能才占优的预期，表明太阳能已经具备一定的持续供电能力。
• [toomuchtodo] 提出加州有望比2045年更早实现其电池储能目标，依据是储能成本下降和制造能力的提升，暗示能源储存技术的快速发展将加速能源转型。
• [adenta] 关注工业规模的海水淡化利用多余电力何时能够实现，暗示未来如果可再生能源发电量持续增长，可能会有新的应用场景，如大规模海水淡化。
• [thedrbrian] 对电价表示关注，质疑太阳能是否真的提供了最便宜的电力，反映出对可再生能源经济性的潜在担忧。

补充讨论：
• 评论中涉及了对太阳能实际发电效果的惊讶（kibwen），以及对未来能源储存技术快速发展的乐观预期（toomuchtodo）。
• 潜在争议焦点在于太阳能的经济性问题（thedrbrian），即太阳能是否真的能提供最便宜的电力，这关系到其大规模推广的可行性。
• 另一个值得注意的讨论点是未来多余电力在海水淡化等工业应用中的潜力（adenta），表明可再生能源的发展可能带动其他行业的创新应用。

44512968.article_content:
Over the past year, solar generation surpassed natural gas to become California’s leading source of electricity, a milestone expected to persist.
Data from the U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA), processed by Ember’s
US Electricity Data Explorer
, shows that in the 12 months ending April 2025, solar generated 83.1 terawatt-hours (TWh) of electricity, compared to 81.6 TWh from natural gas.
Image: Ember
During that period, California generated a total of 244.9 TWh, with solar accounting for 33.9% of the state’s electricity and gas contributing 33.3%.
Natural gas accounts for nearly all fossil fuel use in California’s power generation, with just 0.1% of the state’s electricity coming from coal and 0.02% from other fossil sources. In total, about two-thirds of the state’s electricity now comes from emissions-free sources.
The shift in rankings between solar and gas is primarily due to the sharp increase in solar generation, though natural gas has also declined as a share of the mix.
Image: Ember
From 2014, when the EIA began tracking distributed solar, through the end of 2024, solar grew from 7% of California’s electricity to more than 32%. Over the same period, natural gas fell from nearly 59% to 35% in 2024, and to 33.3% over the most recent 12 months.
Yet the total amount of gas burned has declined only slightly and has essentially stagnated since 2017. Gas generation peaked at just over 88 TWh in 2017, falling to about 86 TWh in 2024. This represents a decrease of just 2.3% over nearly a decade, based on a slightly cherry-picked comparison.
More recently, however, the rate of decline has accelerated, likely driven by
battery capacity deployments
combined with additional solar. This has enabled
greater solar utilization
, particularly during the gas-dominated evening peaking periods. Comparing the first four months of 2024 to the same period in 2023, gas generation fell more than 18% and is down 12% compared to the same period in 2017.
Image: Ember
California’s battery fleet now plays a central role in shifting solar power into the evening. As of April 2025, the state had installed more than 15.7 GW of battery capacity, briefly becoming the
grid’s largest electricity source
during evening peaks. Storage has doubled roughly every 1.2 years, now exceeding 10 GW of output and about 40 GWh of total energy.
Nationally, solar generation continues to climb. In April, solar supplied
10.64% of U.S. electricity
for the month (marking the first time the country crossed the 10% mark) and contributed 7.35% of generation over the rolling 12 months. California, by comparison, produced 42% of its electricity from solar at its seasonal peak in April, with May expected to push that figure even higher.

data.title: Knowing Steam players are hoarders explains why you give Valve that 30%
data.author: musha68k
data.article_summary: 游戏行业分析师Chris Zukowski指出，Steam玩家往往大量购买游戏但并不实际游玩，这种“囤积”行为类似于收藏爱好。他引用Netflix联合创始人Reed Hastings的观点，说明竞争不仅来自其他游戏，还包括睡眠等活动。Zukowski认为，Steam的成功在于其培养了一群狂热的 hobbyists，他们购买游戏是为了收藏而非消费。文章还提到，Simon Carless的研究显示，Steam上51.5%的游戏未被玩家游玩。Zukowski强调，这种囤积行为实际上对开发者有利，因为玩家即使不玩也会购买，使得游戏销售量增加。他进一步指出，明确游戏类型有助于提高在Steam上的表现，因为玩家会根据喜好购买。总的来说，Steam玩家更像是“收藏家”，而非单纯的消费者。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Steam平台的价值、30%分成是否合理、游戏购买和消费习惯

不同观点：
• **支持Steam 30%分成的观点**：
  - **umvi**：30%费用合理，因为Steam不仅提供市场曝光，还通过推荐算法帮助独立开发者触及更多玩家。其自动推荐功能和页面下方的"更多类似推荐"栏位增加了游戏的可见性。
  - **darth_avocado**：Steam能以$4.99的价格提供优质游戏，而实体店如GameStop售价更高，且不打折。
  - **999900000999**：Steam为Linux用户提供良好支持，是PC游戏的首选平台。

• **质疑Steam 30%分成的观点**：
  - **cowthulhu**：30%的分成过高，原因是Steam在PC游戏分发上接近垄断地位，而非因为其服务价值。如果未来有更多竞争，Valve会被迫降低分成比例。
  - **andrewmcwatters**：独立开发者在Steam上发布游戏的税收和分成负担沉重，且玩家社区管理困难，尤其当主要用户是青少年时，环境更加恶劣。

• **关于游戏购买习惯的讨论**：
  - **Apreche**：采取严格的自制策略，只购买当下立刻会玩的游戏，避免因折扣而产生FOMO（错失恐惧症）。
  - **vjk800**：习惯在Steam促销时购买大量游戏，尽管知道不会全玩，因为未来可能有兴趣玩，且促销时不买以后可能错过折扣。
  - **PaulHoule**：游戏积压（backlog）是普遍现象，不仅限于Steam，其他平台如XBOX也有类似情况。购买打折游戏是一种消费习惯，和买衣服等实物商品类似。

• **关于打折和积压游戏的争议**：
  - **octaane**：打折捆绑销售（如Humble Bundle）和购买全价AAA游戏的消费不能等同，前者可能导致虚高的游戏数量统计。
  - **gwbas1c**：质疑Steam上玩家未玩游戏的比例，询问其中有多少是通过免费样品或捆绑包获得的。
  - **gharman**：类似情况不仅限于游戏，其他数字媒体如BJJ Fanatics的教学视频也有类似消费和使用模式。
  - **watwut**：认为51.5%的未玩游戏比例并不算高，尤其是游戏价格低廉且不占用物理空间，批评文章对这一现象的道德化描述。

补充讨论：
- **Steam的垄断地位与竞争**：部分讨论者提到Steam的垄断地位使其能够收取30%的高分成，期待未来有更多竞争以迫使Steam降低分成比例。
- **游戏消费的文化现象**：游戏积压和打折购买成为一种普遍的消费习惯，类似于其他实物商品的购买行为。
- **独立开发者的困境**：独立开发者不仅面临高额税收和分成，还需应对玩家社区管理问题，整体环境充满挑战。

44512336.article_content:
(Image credit: Valve software)
Hold up folks: games industry analyst Chris Zukowski has cracked it, and knows exactly what you're all like. Nothing but a bunch of hoardy hoarders! Yes I'm looking at YOU with your huge Steam library, bulked-out greedily during every big sale, and which you've only ever played half of (and that's being generous). The truth… is in there.
"The amazing thing about Steam and its player base is that they buy games they aren’t going to play,"
says Zukowski in a new post
(
first spotted by GR+
). "More than likely the person buying your game is not going to play it."
I resemble that remark. Zukowski conjures up the spirit of Reed Hastings, the co-founder of Netflix, and specifically his remarks that the streaming platform isn't just competing with the likes of HBO, but also things like Fortnite and, in the extreme cases where you get hooked on a box set and it's past 1 am, sleep. In such a scenario, what chance does a poor little indie game have of snatching an hour?
